# Targets/collocations<TAB>English<TAB>Simplified Chinese
witness^bear witness to 见证……|wonder^wonder whether 想知道是否……|wonderful^a wonderful opportunity 绝好机会|workshop^a training workshop 培训研讨会
column2: Witnesses at the workshop wondered whether a wonderful opportunity to rebuild trust would be lost if officials refused to answer basic questions.
column3: 研讨会上的见证者想知道，如果官员拒绝回答基本问题，是否会失去重建信任的绝好机会。

column1: worldwide^worldwide attention 全球关注|worship^hero worship 英雄崇拜|worthy^be worthy of 值得……|wound^a deep wound 深深伤口
column2: Worldwide hero worship can obscure the deep wounds left by a leader's decisions, making critical examination more worthy of attention than simple praise.
column3: 全球性的英雄崇拜，可能掩盖领导者的决定留下的深深伤口，因此批判性审视比简单赞美更值得关注。

column1: wrap^wrap up 完成；包好|wrench^a wrench in the works 妨碍进展的因素；a wrench 扳手
column2: Repair workers found every replacement wrench wrapped in several layers of plastic, raising questions about waste in supposedly sustainable supply chains.
column3: 维修工人发现，每把替换扳手都裹了几层塑料，引发了对所谓可持续供应链中浪费的质疑。

column1: wreck^wreck a plan 破坏计划|wrinkle^a wrinkle in ……中的小问题
column2: A small wrinkle in a plan need not wreck the whole project if staff are encouraged to report problems before they become expensive failures.
column3: 如果鼓励员工在问题变成代价高昂的失败前报告，计划中的小问题就未必会毁掉整个项目。

column1: yard^a school yard 学校院子|yawn^give a yawn 打哈欠|yield^crop yields 作物产量|youngster^a group of youngsters 一群年轻人
column2: Youngsters who yawned through lessons about crop yields became curious when they grew vegetables in the school yard themselves.
column3: 听作物产量课时打哈欠的孩子，自己在学校院子种菜后，却变得充满好奇。

column1: youth^in one's youth 在年轻时|zeal^with zeal 热情地|zigzag^a zigzag path 曲折小路|zip^zip up 拉上拉链
column2: Recalling the zeal of their youth, older volunteers zipped up their jackets and followed a zigzag path to help restore the hillside.
column3: 年长志愿者想起年轻时的热情，拉上夹克拉链，沿着曲折小路前去帮助恢复山坡植被。

column1: zone^a pedestrian zone 步行区|zoom^zoom in on 放大查看……
column2: Zooming in on the map revealed that the proposed pedestrian zone excluded the very streets where children faced the greatest traffic risks.
column3: 放大地图后发现，拟议步行区恰好排除了儿童面临最大交通风险的街道。

column1: salary^an annual salary 年薪|sample^a representative sample 代表性样本|sanction^economic sanctions 经济制裁|sarcastic^a sarcastic remark 讽刺评论
column2: Sarcastic remarks about high salaries were no substitute for a representative sample showing how economic sanctions affected workers across different industries.
column3: 对高薪的讽刺评论，不能代替具有代表性的样本，后者才能显示经济制裁如何影响不同行业的工人。

column1: satellite^satellite images 卫星图像|satisfaction^job satisfaction 工作满意度|satisfactory^a satisfactory explanation 令人满意的解释|scan^scan for 扫描寻找……
column2: Staff scanning satellite images reported greater job satisfaction when managers offered satisfactory explanations of how their work supported disaster prevention.
column3: 扫描卫星图像的员工表示，如果管理者能充分解释其工作如何支持防灾，他们的工作满意度会更高。

column1: scarce^scarce resources 稀缺资源|scarcely^scarcely any 几乎没有|scenario^a possible scenario 可能情景|scene^behind the scenes 在幕后
column2: Behind the scenes, planners examined scenarios in which resources became so scarce that communities had scarcely any capacity to respond.
column3: 规划者在幕后研究了各种情景，其中资源会变得极为稀缺，社区几乎无力应对。

column1: scenery^natural scenery 自然风景|scholar^a visiting scholar 访问学者|scholarship^win a scholarship 获得奖学金|science^social science 社会科学
column2: A visiting scholar in social science used a scholarship to study how images of natural scenery shape decisions about rural development.
column3: 一位社会科学访问学者，利用奖学金研究自然风景图像如何影响乡村发展决策。

column1: scientific^scientific evidence 科学证据|scorn^scorn for 对……的轻蔑|scrap^scrap metal 废金属|scrape^scrape off 刮掉
column2: Scientific evidence challenged the scorn directed at scrap collectors, whose work scraping paint off old metal could recover valuable materials.
column3: 科学证据对轻视废品回收者的态度提出了质疑，他们刮除旧金属油漆的工作，可以回收有价值的材料。

column1: scratch^from scratch 从零开始|scream^scream for help 尖叫求救|script^a film script 电影剧本|scrutiny^under scrutiny 受到审查
column2: A film script about workers screaming for help came under scrutiny when investigators found that its account had been invented from scratch.
column3: 一部描写工人尖叫求救的电影剧本受到审查，因为调查者发现其叙述完全是凭空编造的。

column1: sculpture^a stone sculpture 石雕|section^a cross section 横截面；a section of ……的一部分|secure^secure funding 获得资金|security^job security 工作保障
column2: The museum secured funding for a new sculpture section, but staff questioned why investment in displays took priority over job security.
column3: 博物馆为新的雕塑展区获得资金，但员工质疑为什么投资展陈优先于工作保障。

column1: seemingly^a seemingly simple 看似简单的……|segment^a market segment 细分市场|seize^seize an opportunity 抓住机会|seldom^seldom if ever 极少；几乎从不
column2: A seemingly simple product can help firms seize opportunities in a market segment that larger competitors seldom notice.
column3: 一种看似简单的产品，可能帮助企业抓住大竞争者极少关注的细分市场机会。

column1: select^select from 从……中选择|selection^a selection of 一系列……|senior^senior management 高层管理人员|sensation^a sensation of ……的感觉
column2: Senior managers selecting office designs should consider users' sensations of privacy rather than judge the selection solely by appearance.
column3: 高管挑选办公室设计时，应考虑使用者的隐私感，而非仅凭外观作选择。

column1: sense^make sense 有道理|sequence^a sequence of 一连串……|serious^a serious problem 严重问题|serve^serve a purpose 起作用
column2: A sequence of small warnings may signal a serious problem, so it makes sense to ask what purpose each safety check actually serves.
column3: 一连串小警告可能预示严重问题，因此有必要问清每项安全检查究竟发挥什么作用。

column1: service^public services 公共服务|session^a training session 培训课|setback^a temporary setback 暂时挫折|setting^a classroom setting 课堂环境
column2: A training session that works in a classroom setting may encounter setbacks when staff try to apply it while delivering busy public services.
column3: 一堂在课堂环境中有效的培训课，可能在员工忙于提供公共服务并尝试应用时遭遇挫折。

column1: settle^settle a dispute 解决争议|several^several times 几次|shadow^cast a shadow over 给……蒙上阴影|shame^a sense of shame 羞耻感
column2: Several failed attempts to settle the dispute cast a shadow over the project, while employees felt shame for problems they had not caused.
column3: 几次解决争议的尝试失败，给项目蒙上阴影，员工却为并非自己造成的问题感到羞耻。

column1: share^share information 共享信息|shape^shape the future 塑造未来|shatter^shatter confidence 摧毁信心|shift^a shift in ……的转变
column2: A shift towards sharing information can shape a more open workplace, but one serious breach of trust may shatter confidence in the whole system.
column3: 转向信息共享可以塑造更开放的职场，但一次严重失信就可能摧毁人们对整个系统的信心。

column1: shortage^a shortage of ……的短缺|shortcoming^a major shortcoming 主要不足|shrink^shrink by 缩减了……|shut^shut down 关闭
column2: A staffing shortage forced the service to shut down temporarily, exposing the shortcomings of plans that assumed demand would shrink as funding fell.
column3: 人手短缺迫使服务暂时关闭，暴露出一项计划的不足：它假定资金下降时，需求也会随之缩小。

column1: side^on the other side 在另一面|sideways^move sideways 侧向移动|sign^a sign of ……的迹象|signature^a signature on ……上的签名
column2: A signature on the other side of the form was no sign of informed consent when the screen forced readers to scroll sideways to see the terms.
column3: 如果屏幕迫使读者横向滚动才能看到条款，那么表格另一面的签名并不代表知情同意。

column1: silence^break the silence 打破沉默|silent^remain silent 保持沉默|significant^a significant difference 显著差异|significance^the significance of ……的重要性
column2: The significant pay gap took on new significance when employees broke their silence, revealing why junior staff had remained silent for so long.
column3: 员工打破沉默、揭示初级员工为何长期不发声后，显著薪酬差距的问题呈现出新的重要性。

column1: similar^be similar to 与……相似|simplicity^for simplicity 为简便起见|simply^not simply 不仅仅|simulate^simulate conditions 模拟条件
column2: Similar results in simulated conditions do not simply prove real-world success; the simplicity of the model may hide important differences.
column3: 模拟条件下相似的结果，并不能直接证明现实成功；模型的简化可能掩盖重要差异。

column1: sincere^a sincere apology 真诚道歉|single^single out 挑出；特别选出|situation^in a situation 处于一种情况|sketch^sketch out 概述
column2: A sincere apology should sketch out how a difficult situation will be corrected rather than single out one employee for blame.
column3: 真诚的道歉应概述如何纠正困境，而非挑出某一名员工来责怪。

column1: skin^skin care 护肤|skip^skip a step 跳过步骤|slack^slack demand 需求疲弱|slice^a slice of ……的一部分
column2: When demand is slack, firms seeking a larger slice of the skin-care market may be tempted to skip essential testing steps.
column3: 需求疲弱时，寻求更大护肤市场份额的企业，可能想跳过必要检测步骤。

column1: slide^a slide in ……的下降|slight^a slight increase 小幅增加|slim^a slim chance 渺茫机会|slip^slip into 悄然陷入……
column2: A slight increase in costs can leave small firms with only a slim chance of survival if a slide in sales slips into a prolonged decline.
column3: 如果销售下滑演变为长期衰退，小幅成本上升就可能使小企业的生存机会变得渺茫。

column1: slogan^a campaign slogan 活动口号|smooth^a smooth transition 平稳过渡|smuggle^smuggle goods 走私货物|snap^a snap decision 仓促决定
column2: Slogans promising a smooth border crossing cannot justify snap decisions that make it easier to smuggle goods past essential checks.
column3: 承诺顺畅通关的口号，不能为让货物更容易逃避必要检查的仓促决定辩护。

column1: snatch^snatch an opportunity 抢抓机会|sneak^sneak into 溜入……|so-called^so-called experts 所谓专家|soak^soak up 吸收……
column2: So-called experts may sneak advertising into advice, snatching the opportunity to sell while readers soak up information they assume is independent.
column3: 所谓专家可能把广告悄悄放进建议中，趁读者吸收自以为独立的信息时，抓住机会推销。

column1: sociable^a sociable person 合群的人|social^social interaction 社会交往|socialism^democratic socialism 民主社会主义|society^a civil society 公民社会
column2: Debates about socialism and market society should examine how institutions support social interaction, rather than assume that sociable behaviour follows from one economic label.
column3: 关于社会主义与市场社会的争论，应考察制度如何支持社会交往，而非假定某种经济标签自然带来合群行为。

column1: software^software development 软件开发|solar^solar power 太阳能|solemn^a solemn promise 郑重承诺|solution^a solution to ……的解决办法
column2: A solemn promise to expand solar power needs practical solutions, including software that helps balance electricity supply as sunlight changes.
column3: 扩大太阳能使用的郑重承诺，需要实际解决方案，包括随日照变化帮助平衡电力供应的软件。

column1: solve^solve a problem 解决问题|sophisticated^a sophisticated system 复杂精密系统
column2: A sophisticated system does not necessarily solve a problem better than a simple one if users cannot understand how to operate it.
column3: 如果用户不懂如何操作，复杂精密的系统未必比简单系统更能解决问题。

column1: sophomore^a college sophomore 大学二年级学生|sorrow^express sorrow 表达悲痛
column2: A college sophomore coping with sorrow after a family loss may need understanding and practical support rather than pressure to resume normal performance immediately.
column3: 大学二年级学生经历亲人离世、承受悲伤时，可能需要理解与实际支持，而非被催促立即恢复正常表现。

column1: spacecraft^a manned spacecraft 载人飞船|spacious^a spacious room 宽敞房间
column2: A spacious exhibition allowed visitors to walk around a spacecraft and understand how limited room shapes the design of long missions.
column3: 宽敞的展览让游客可以绕着航天器行走，理解有限空间如何影响长期任务的设计。

column1: source^a source of ……的来源|spade^call a spade a spade 实话实说
column2: Calling a spade a spade in environmental debate means acknowledging the sources of pollution even when they are economically important to a town.
column3: 环境讨论中实话实说，意味着承认污染来源，即使它们对一座城镇的经济很重要。

column1: span^a life span 寿命|spare^spare parts 备件|spark^spark interest 激起兴趣|sparkle^sparkle in the light 在光线下闪耀
column2: A device sparkling under exhibition lights may spark interest, but its life span depends on whether affordable spare parts remain available.
column3: 在展灯下闪耀的设备或许引人兴趣，但寿命取决于今后能否继续获得价格合理的备件。

column1: special^special needs 特殊需求|specialise^specialise in 专门研究……|specialist^a specialist in ……方面的专家|speciality^a local speciality 当地特产
column2: Specialists who specialise in food education can explain local specialities while helping schools meet children's special dietary needs.
column3: 专门从事饮食教育的专家，可以在介绍当地特色食品的同时，帮助学校满足儿童特殊饮食需要。

column1: specification^technical specifications 技术规格|specify^specify the conditions 明确条件|spectacular^spectacular scenery 壮丽景色|speculate^speculate about 推测……
column2: Technical specifications should specify what a camera can capture, rather than leave buyers speculating about whether spectacular scenery in advertisements reflects ordinary results.
column3: 技术规格应说明相机能够拍到什么，而非让买家猜测广告里的壮丽景色是否代表日常效果。

column1: speech^freedom of speech 言论自由|speed^at high speed 高速地|spill^an oil spill 石油泄漏|spin^spin out of control 失去控制
column2: News of an oil spill spread at high speed, and officials' attempts to restrict speech risked making public distrust spin out of control.
column3: 石油泄漏消息高速传播，官员限制言论的尝试，可能使公众的不信任失去控制。

column1: spirit^a spirit of cooperation 合作精神|spite^in spite of 尽管……
column2: In spite of limited funding, volunteers restored the park in a spirit of cooperation, showing what local groups could achieve with reliable support.
column3: 尽管资金有限，志愿者仍以合作精神修复公园，展示了地方团体获得可靠支持后能够做到什么。

column1: spit^spit out 吐出|splash^splash into 溅入……
column2: Water splashed onto the pavement as workers cleaned the street, while passing trucks raised dust that made them cough and spit.
column3: 工人清扫街道时，水溅到人行道上，而过往卡车扬起灰尘，让他们咳嗽、吐痰。

column1: splendid^a splendid example 绝佳例子|spokesman^a government spokesman 政府发言人|sponge^like a sponge 像海绵一样|sponsor^sponsor an event 赞助活动
column2: A government spokesman praised the sponsored park as a splendid example of using soil like a sponge to absorb heavy rainfall.
column3: 一位政府发言人称赞这座受资助的公园，是利用土壤像海绵一样吸收暴雨的绝佳例子。

column1: spot^spot a mistake 发现错误|spray^spray A with B 用B喷洒A|sprinkle^sprinkle A on B 将A撒在B上|sprout^sprout up 迅速出现
column2: Gardeners spotted new shoots sprouting after they sprinkled compost on the soil and sprayed the beds with water rather than chemicals.
column3: 园丁把堆肥撒在土上，并用清水而非化学品喷洒花坛后，发现新芽长了出来。

column1: spur^spur someone to do 激励某人做……|square^a public square 公共广场|squeeze^squeeze into 挤进……|stability^financial stability 财务稳定
column2: Crowds squeezed into the public square, spurring officials to discuss how rising rents threatened the financial stability of ordinary households.
column3: 人群挤进公共广场，促使官员讨论租金上涨如何威胁普通家庭的财务稳定。

column1: stable^a stable income 稳定收入|stadium^a sports stadium 体育场|stagger^stagger working hours 错开工作时间|stain^a stain on 对……的污点
column2: The stadium offered stable jobs with staggered hours, but unpaid wages remained a stain on the event's claim to social responsibility.
column3: 体育场提供了错峰上班的稳定岗位，但拖欠工资仍是赛事所宣称的社会责任上的污点。

column1: staircase^a spiral staircase 螺旋楼梯|stake^at stake 处于危险中；利害攸关|stamp^a postage stamp 邮票|stance^take a stance on 对……表态
column2: Campaigners placed stamps showing the old staircase on letters urging officials to take a clear stance on the heritage at stake.
column3: 活动人士在信件上贴上印着老楼梯的邮票，敦促官员对面临风险的文化遗产明确表态。

column1: standard^living standards 生活水平|standpoint^from the standpoint of 从……的立场|stare^stare at 凝视……|statement^issue a statement 发表声明
column2: From residents' standpoint, a statement promising higher living standards meant little while they stared at unfinished homes.
column3: 在居民看来，当他们只能望着未完工的住房时，承诺提高生活水平的声明意义不大。

column1: station^a bus station 公交车站|stationary^remain stationary 保持静止
column2: Buses remained stationary at the station because a shortage of affordable spare parts prevented mechanics from completing repairs.
column3: 由于缺少价格合理的备件，机修人员无法完成维修，公交车一直停在车站里。

column1: stationery^office stationery 办公文具|statistics^official statistics 官方统计
column2: Statistics on stationery purchases can reveal waste, but small savings on paper should not distract managers from much larger operating costs.
column3: 文具采购统计可以揭示浪费，但纸张上的小额节省，不应使管理者忽略大得多的运营成本。

column1: steady^steady growth 稳定增长|steal^steal data 窃取数据|steep^a steep rise 急剧上升|steer^steer clear of 避开……
column2: Steady growth in online shopping was followed by a steep rise in stolen data, steering cautious consumers away from unfamiliar retailers.
column3: 网上购物稳定增长之后，数据失窃急剧增加，使谨慎消费者避开不熟悉的零售商。

column1: stem^stem from 源于……|stereotype^a gender stereotype 性别刻板印象|stern^a stern warning 严厉警告|sting^a bee sting 蜂蜇
column2: A stern warning about bee stings may seem sensible, but children's fear can also stem from stereotypes that portray every insect as dangerous.
column3: 严厉警告蜂蜇似乎合理，但儿童的恐惧也可能源于把所有昆虫都描述为危险的刻板印象。

column1: stipulate^stipulate that 规定……|stir^stir up 激起……|stock^in stock 有现货|stocking^stocking up on 储备……
column2: The agreement stipulated minimum food stocks, but rumours of shortages stirred panic and encouraged households to start stocking up unnecessarily.
column3: 协议规定了最低食品库存，但短缺传言引起恐慌，促使家庭进行不必要的囤货。

column1: stomach^on an empty stomach 空腹|storage^data storage 数据存储|store^store information 存储信息|straight^go straight to 直接前往……
column2: Workers went straight to their stations on empty stomachs, while management focused on storing more data rather than providing basic food storage facilities.
column3: 工人空腹直接上岗，而管理层只关注存储更多数据，没有提供基本的食品储存设施。

column1: straightforward^a straightforward explanation 简明解释|strand^a strand of ……的一部分|strange^a strange phenomenon 奇怪现象|stranger^a complete stranger 完全陌生的人
column2: One strand of the research offered a straightforward explanation for a strange phenomenon: people sometimes trust complete strangers more than familiar institutions.
column3: 研究的一部分，对一个奇怪现象提供了简明解释：人们有时更信任完全陌生的人，而非熟悉的机构。

column1: strategy^a long-term strategy 长期策略|stream^a stream of 一连串……|strength^a source of strength 力量来源|strengthen^strengthen cooperation 加强合作
column2: A long-term strategy can strengthen cooperation by turning a stream of local complaints into a source of shared strength.
column3: 长期策略可以把源源不断的地方投诉转化为共同力量，从而加强合作。

column1: stress^under stress 承受压力|stretch^stretch resources 使资源紧张|strict^strict rules 严格规则|string^a string of 一连串……
column2: A string of strict rules placed staff under stress and stretched resources without showing which measures actually improved safety.
column3: 一连串严格规定让员工承受压力、资源变得紧张，却未说明哪些措施真正改善了安全。

column1: strive^strive for 努力争取……|structure^a social structure 社会结构|stubborn^a stubborn problem 顽固问题|stumble^stumble upon 偶然发现……
column2: Researchers striving for a simple answer stumbled upon a stubborn problem: social structures mattered more than the individual choices their model measured.
column3: 努力寻找简单答案的研究者，偶然发现了一个顽固问题：社会结构比模型衡量的个人选择更重要。

column1: style^a management style 管理风格|subjective^a subjective judgment 主观判断|submerge^be submerged in 淹没于……|subsequent^subsequent events 后续事件
column2: Subsequent events showed that subjective judgments about management style had submerged a more important debate about wages and working hours.
column3: 后续事件表明，对管理风格的主观判断，淹没了更重要的工资与工时讨论。

column1: substance^a harmful substance 有害物质|subtract^subtract A from B 从B中减去A|suburb^a residential suburb 住宅郊区|success^the key to success 成功关键
column2: Measuring harmful substances in the suburb was a success, but subtracting background pollution from the total required further analysis.
column3: 测量郊区有害物质取得了成功，但要从总量中扣除背景污染，还需要进一步分析。

column1: successful^be successful in 在……方面成功|sudden^a sudden change 突变|suffer^suffer from 遭受……|suffice^suffice to say 可以说
column2: It suffices to say that successful firms can still suffer from sudden changes when their plans depend too heavily on yesterday's demand.
column3: 可以说，即使成功企业，如果计划过分依赖过去的需求，也可能遭受突然变化的冲击。

column1: suggest^suggest doing 建议做……|suggestion^make a suggestion 提建议|suicide^suicide prevention 自杀预防|suit^suit someone's needs 适合某人需要
column2: Suggestions for suicide prevention should suit local needs, and researchers suggest listening to affected communities before designing support services.
column3: 自杀预防建议应适合当地需要，研究者建议在设计支持服务之前，先倾听相关社区的声音。

column1: suitable^be suitable for 适合……|suite^a suite of 一套……|sum^sum up 总结|summarise^summarise the findings 概括结果
column2: A suitable suite of evaluation tools should summarise the findings without reducing every important difference to a single sum.
column3: 一套合适的评估工具，应概括研究结果，而不把所有重要差异都压缩成一个总数。

column1: summary^in summary 总之|summit^a climate summit 气候峰会|summon^summon a meeting 召集会议|super^super-efficient 极高效的
column2: In summary, even super-efficient technology cannot replace political cooperation, which is why leaders summon experts to meet at an international climate summit.
column3: 总的来说，即使极高效的技术也不能取代政治合作，这就是领导人召集专家在国际气候峰会会面的原因。

column1: superb^a superb example 极佳例子|superior^be superior to 优于……|superiority^a sense of superiority 优越感|supermarket^a supermarket chain 连锁超市
column2: A supermarket chain's superb service may be superior to its rivals', but a sense of superiority can prevent managers from noticing new customer needs.
column3: 一家连锁超市的卓越服务可能优于对手，但优越感会阻碍管理者发现顾客的新需要。

column1: supervise^supervise work 监督工作|supplement^supplement income 补充收入|supply^supply and demand 供求|support^in support of 支持……
column2: Staff supervising volunteers who supplement public services must offer support, especially when the supply of trained workers falls short of demand.
column3: 监督那些补充公共服务的志愿者的员工，必须提供支持，尤其当受训人员供给不足时。

column1: suppose^be supposed to 应该；被认为|suppress^suppress information 压制信息|surface^on the surface 表面上|surge^a surge in ……的激增
column2: On the surface, complaints surged suddenly, but information that officials were supposed to release had been suppressed for months.
column3: 表面上，投诉是突然激增的，但官员本应公布的信息，已经被压制数月。

column1: surgeon^a heart surgeon 心脏外科医生|surgery^undergo surgery 接受手术|surpass^surpass expectations 超过预期
column2: Even when surgery surpasses expectations, a surgeon should explain the limits of the result and the support a patient may still need.
column3: 即使手术效果超过预期，外科医生也应解释结果的局限，以及患者可能仍需要的支持。

column1: surname^a family surname 姓氏
column2: Using surnames alone to identify people can create mistakes, especially when several members of a community share the same family name.
column3: 只用姓氏识别人可能造成错误，尤其当社区多名成员拥有相同姓氏时。

column1: surprise^to someone's surprise 令某人惊讶的是|surrender^surrender control 交出控制权|surround^be surrounded by 被……环绕|surroundings^familiar surroundings 熟悉环境
column2: To their surprise, residents surrounded by new technology felt they had surrendered control over surroundings that had once been familiar.
column3: 令居民惊讶的是，置身新技术包围中，他们却觉得失去了对曾经熟悉的环境的控制。

column1: survey^conduct a survey 开展调查|survival^a matter of survival 生存问题|survive^survive a crisis 挺过危机|susceptible^be susceptible to 易受……影响
column2: A survey of firms that survived the crisis found that survival often depended on whether they were susceptible to sudden changes in credit.
column3: 一项针对挺过危机的企业的调查发现，生存往往取决于它们是否容易受信贷突变影响。

column1: suspect^suspect someone of 怀疑某人……|suspend^suspend a service 暂停服务|suspicion^on suspicion of 因涉嫌……|suspicious^be suspicious of 对……怀疑
column2: The service was suspended on suspicion of fraud, but suspicious customers asked why officials had not investigated the problems they already suspected.
column3: 服务因涉嫌欺诈被暂停，但疑虑重重的顾客质问，官员为何没有调查他们早已怀疑的问题。

column1: sustain^sustain growth 维持增长|sway^sway public opinion 影响舆论|swear^swear to do 发誓做……|sweep^sweep away 清除……
column2: Leaders swore to sustain growth, but a wave of criticism swept away old assurances and swayed public opinion towards stronger environmental rules.
column3: 领导者发誓维持增长，但一波批评冲淡了旧有保证，使舆论转向支持更强的环保规定。

column1: swing^a swing in ……的转变|switch^switch to 转向……|symbol^a symbol of ……的象征|symmetry^a sense of symmetry 对称感
column2: A swing towards cycling made the bicycle a symbol of urban renewal, while planners switched from visual symmetry to practical access when redesigning streets.
column3: 转向骑行的潮流，使自行车成为城市更新的象征，规划者重新设计街道时，也从视觉对称转向实际通达性。

column1: sympathetic^be sympathetic to 同情；赞同|sympathise^sympathise with 同情……|sympathy^have sympathy for 同情……|synthesis^a synthesis of ……的综合
column2: A synthesis of interviews showed that managers expressed sympathy for overworked staff, but being sympathetic did not always mean sympathising with demands for shorter hours.
column3: 访谈的综合结果表明，管理者对过劳员工表达同情，但态度同情并不总意味着赞同缩短工时的要求。

column1: synthetic^synthetic materials 合成材料|system^a public transport system 公共交通系统|taboo^a social taboo 社会禁忌|tackle^tackle a problem 处理问题
column2: Tackling waste from synthetic materials requires a better collection system, not treating discussion of consumption as a social taboo.
column3: 解决合成材料垃圾问题，需要更好的收集系统，而非把讨论消费视为社会禁忌。

column1: tactic^a marketing tactic 营销策略|tailor^tailor A to B 使A适合B|talent^attract talent 吸引人才|tangible^tangible benefits 实际收益
column2: Recruitment tactics tailored to young talent should offer tangible benefits rather than vague promises about a lively office culture.
column3: 针对年轻人才定制的招聘策略，应提供实际收益，而非含糊承诺活跃的办公室文化。

column1: tangle^a tangle of 一团……|tank^a water tank 水箱|target^meet a target 达到目标|tariff^import tariffs 进口关税
column2: Import tariffs on water tanks created a tangle of costs that made it harder for housing projects to meet energy-saving targets.
column3: 水箱进口关税带来一团复杂成本，使住房项目更难达到节能目标。

column1: technical^technical skills 技术技能|technician^a skilled technician 熟练技术员|technique^a research technique 研究方法|technology^information technology 信息技术
column2: New technology changes the techniques technicians use, but technical training must still explain why each step matters rather than merely show which button to press.
column3: 新技术改变技术员使用的方法，但技术培训仍必须解释每一步为什么重要，而非只演示按哪个按钮。

column1: telephone^a telephone interview 电话访谈|temper^lose one's temper 发脾气|temperament^a calm temperament 冷静性情|temperature^room temperature 室温
column2: In telephone interviews, workers said that high room temperatures tested even calm temperaments and made people more likely to lose their temper.
column3: 电话访谈中，工人表示，高室温甚至考验性情冷静的人，让人更容易发脾气。

column1: temple^an ancient temple 古庙|temporary^a temporary measure 临时措施|tempt^tempt someone to do 诱使某人做……|tend^tend to do 往往做……
column2: Temporary limits on visitors to the temple tended to reduce damage, tempting officials to make the restrictions permanent.
column3: 对寺庙游客的临时限流往往减少损坏，促使官员考虑让限制永久化。

column1: tendency^a tendency to do 做……的倾向|tender^put out to tender 招标|tense^a tense situation 紧张局势|tension^ease tensions 缓和紧张关系
column2: Putting contracts out to tender may reduce the tendency to favor familiar firms, but explaining the process is essential to easing tensions in a tense market.
column3: 合同招标可能减少偏袒熟悉企业的倾向，但在紧张的市场中，解释流程对缓和矛盾至关重要。

column1: terminal^a bus terminal 公交总站；terminal illness 绝症|terminate^terminate a contract 终止合同|terrible^a terrible mistake 严重错误|terrific^a terrific opportunity 极好机会
column2: A terrific opportunity to rebuild the bus terminal ended in a terrible dispute when the council terminated the contract without explaining why.
column3: 重建公交总站的极好机会，因市政委员会不解释原因就终止合同，而以严重争议告终。

column1: terrify^be terrified of 害怕……|territory^unknown territory 未知领域|terror^in terror 惊恐地|testify^testify to 证明；作证
column2: Workers terrified of speaking in unfamiliar legal territory nevertheless testified to the terror created by threats of dismissal.
column3: 工人虽然害怕在陌生的法律领域发言，仍作证讲述了解雇威胁造成的恐惧。

column1: testimony^give testimony 作证|textbook^a textbook example 教科书式例子|textile^the textile industry 纺织业|texture^a soft texture 柔软质地
column2: Testimony from textile workers offered a textbook example of how consumers' preference for soft textures could hide difficult production conditions.
column3: 纺织工人的证词提供了一个典型例子，说明消费者对柔软质地的偏好，如何掩盖艰难的生产条件。

column1: theater^a community theater 社区剧场|theory^in theory 理论上|thereafter^shortly thereafter 此后不久|thereby^thereby reducing 从而减少……
column2: In theory, the theater could share equipment with nearby schools, thereby reducing costs; shortly thereafter, a practical agreement made this possible.
column3: 理论上，剧院可以与附近学校共享设备，从而降低成本；此后不久，一项实际协议使之成为可能。

column1: therefore^and therefore 因此|thermal^thermal insulation 隔热材料|thesis^a doctoral thesis 博士论文|thirst^a thirst for 对……的渴望
column2: A doctoral thesis on thermal insulation reflected a thirst for practical knowledge and therefore included measurements from ordinary homes rather than laboratories alone.
column3: 一篇隔热研究博士论文体现了对实践知识的渴求，因此纳入了普通住宅测量，而非仅依赖实验室。

column1: thirsty^be thirsty for 渴望……|thorn^a thorn in someone's side 某人的心头刺|thorough^a thorough investigation 彻底调查|though^even though 即使……
column2: Though officials were thirsty for investment, a thorough investigation showed that unresolved water shortages would remain a thorn in developers' side.
column3: 尽管官员渴望投资，彻底调查仍表明，未解决的缺水问题会继续成为开发商的心头刺。

column1: thought^give thought to 考虑……|thoughtful^a thoughtful response 深思熟虑的回应|thousand^thousands of 数千……|thread^a common thread 共同线索
column2: A common thread in thousands of complaints was that officials gave too little thought to daily life, making a thoughtful response more valuable than another publicity campaign.
column3: 数千条投诉的共同点，是官员对日常生活考虑太少，因此深思熟虑的回应，比又一次宣传活动更有价值。

column1: threat^a threat to 对……的威胁|threaten^threaten to do 威胁要做……|throne^ascend the throne 登基|through^through the lens of 从……视角
column2: Seen through the lens of social history, disputes over the throne reveal how threats to ordinary livelihoods could threaten the stability of a kingdom.
column3: 从社会史视角看，王位争夺揭示了对普通人生计的威胁如何危及王国稳定。

column1: throughout^throughout the world 全世界|thus^thus leading to 从而导致……|tight^a tight budget 紧张预算|tile^roof tiles 屋瓦
column2: Throughout the region, councils on tight budgets delayed replacing roof tiles, thus allowing small leaks to become expensive structural problems.
column3: 整个地区的市政委员会预算紧张，推迟更换屋瓦，从而让小渗漏发展成昂贵的结构性问题。

column1: timely^in a timely manner 及时地|timid^a timid response 怯弱回应|tiny^a tiny fraction 很小一部分|tissue^human tissue 人体组织
column2: A timely donation of human tissue can support research, but tiny participation rates may reflect timid communication rather than public unwillingness.
column3: 及时捐献人体组织可以支持研究，但极低参与率可能反映沟通畏缩，而非公众不愿意。

column1: title^a job title 职位名称|toast^propose a toast 提议祝酒
column2: At the ceremony, employees proposed a toast to a colleague whose contribution mattered far more than the modest title printed on her badge.
column3: 仪式上，员工提议为一位同事祝酒，她的贡献远比徽章上朴素的职位名称重要。

column1: tobacco^tobacco control 烟草控制|tolerance^zero tolerance 零容忍
column2: A zero-tolerance policy on tobacco use in shared indoor spaces requires clear signs and consistent enforcement rather than occasional public warnings.
column3: 共用室内空间的烟草使用零容忍政策，需要清楚标识与持续执行，而非偶尔公开警告。

column1: tolerate^tolerate uncertainty 容忍不确定性|tone^set the tone 定下基调|torment^mental torment 精神折磨|torrent^a torrent of 大量……
column2: A torrent of harsh messages set a hostile tone, making uncertainty harder to tolerate and turning an ordinary dispute into mental torment.
column3: 大量苛刻信息定下敌对基调，使不确定性更难承受，把普通纠纷变成了精神折磨。

column1: torture^psychological torture 心理折磨|toss^toss a coin 抛硬币|total^in total 总共|towards^an attitude towards 对……的态度
column2: Asking workers to toss a coin over who lost a job seemed like psychological torture and changed attitudes towards management more than the total savings justified.
column3: 让工人抛硬币决定谁失业，仿佛一种心理折磨；它对员工看待管理层的影响，远超过节省的总额所能解释的程度。

column1: trace^trace A back to B 将A追溯到B|track^keep track of 跟踪……|trade^free trade 自由贸易|traffic^traffic congestion 交通拥堵
column2: Tracking local trade helped researchers trace worsening traffic congestion back to delivery patterns rather than simply blame an increase in private cars.
column3: 跟踪本地贸易帮助研究者把交通拥堵恶化追溯到配送模式，而非只是归咎于私家车增加。

column1: tragedy^a human tragedy 人间悲剧|tragic^tragic consequences 悲惨后果|trail^leave a trail 留下痕迹|transcend^transcend boundaries 超越界限
column2: The tragedy left a trail of unanswered questions, showing that preventing tragic consequences requires cooperation that transcends administrative boundaries.
column3: 悲剧留下一连串未解问题，说明要防止悲惨后果，需要超越行政边界的合作。

column1: transient^a transient effect 短暂影响|transit^in transit 运输途中|transition^a transition to 向……的过渡|translate^translate A into B 将A转化为B
column2: The transition to cleaner transit will succeed only if short-term enthusiasm translates into lasting habits rather than transient publicity gains.
column3: 向更清洁交通的过渡，只有在短期热情转化为持久习惯，而非短暂宣传收益时，才会成功。

column1: translation^a translation of ……的译文|transplant^an organ transplant 器官移植|transport^public transport 公共交通|trap^a poverty trap 贫困陷阱
column2: A poor translation of transplant records can trap medical teams in confusion about how donated organs were stored during transport.
column3: 移植记录翻译不佳，可能使医疗团队困惑，不清楚捐献器官在运输途中如何保存。

column1: trash^household trash 家庭垃圾|treasure^a national treasure 国宝|treat^treat A as B 把A当作B|tremble^tremble with 因……发抖
column2: Residents trembled with anger when a historic workshop, treated as a national treasure by local people, was filled with discarded trash.
column3: 居民因愤怒发抖，因为一座被当地人视为珍宝的历史作坊，竟堆满废弃垃圾。

column1: trend^a growing trend 日益明显的趋势|tribute^pay tribute to 向……致敬|trick^a marketing trick 营销伎俩|trifle^trifle with 轻视；玩弄
column2: Paying tribute to local workers should not become a marketing trick that trifles with their concerns while ignoring troubling employment trends.
column3: 向本地工人致敬，不应变成轻慢其关切、却忽视不良就业趋势的营销伎俩。

column1: trim^trim costs 削减成本|triumph^a triumph over 战胜……|trivial^a trivial matter 小事|tropic^the Tropic of Cancer 北回归线
column2: Trimming water use near the Tropic of Cancer is not a trivial matter; small savings can represent a triumph over deeply rooted habits.
column3: 在北回归线附近减少用水并非小事，微小节省也可能意味着战胜根深蒂固的习惯。

column1: tropical^a tropical forest 热带森林|troublesome^a troublesome problem 棘手问题|trumpet^trumpet an achievement 鼓吹成就|trust^trust in 对……的信任
column2: Officials trumpeting achievements in tropical forest protection risk losing trust if they fail to acknowledge troublesome evidence of continuing habitat loss.
column3: 官员鼓吹热带森林保护成就时，如果不承认栖息地仍在流失的棘手证据，就可能失去信任。

column1: tuition^tuition fees 学费|tumble^tumble down 跌落；倒塌|tumor^a brain tumor 脑肿瘤|tune^in tune with 与……协调
column2: When a parent's treatment for a tumor sent family income tumbling, tuition support needed to be in tune with rapidly changing circumstances.
column3: 一位家长因肿瘤接受治疗使家庭收入骤降时，学费支持需要适应迅速变化的境况。

column1: tunnel^a railway tunnel 铁路隧道|turbine^a wind turbine 风力涡轮机|turbulent^a turbulent period 动荡时期|turmoil^economic turmoil 经济动荡
column2: During economic turmoil, investment in tunnels and wind turbines may provide stable work, but turbulent markets make long-term planning difficult.
column3: 经济动荡期间，投资隧道与风力涡轮机可能提供稳定工作，但动荡市场让长期规划变得困难。

column1: turnover^staff turnover 员工流动率|tutor^a private tutor 私人教师|typhoon^a powerful typhoon 强台风|typical^be typical of 是……的典型特征
column2: High staff turnover among tutors was typical after the typhoon, as damaged homes forced many teachers to seek work elsewhere.
column3: 台风后，辅导教师流动率高成为典型现象，因为住房受损迫使许多教师到别处找工作。

column1: ugly^an ugly truth 丑陋事实|uncover^uncover the truth 揭露真相|undergo^undergo a change 经历变化|underground^an underground network 地下网络
column2: Repairs to the underground network uncovered an ugly truth: equipment had undergone repeated inspections without serious faults being corrected.
column3: 地下网络维修揭露出一个丑陋事实：设备虽经反复检查，严重故障却从未得到纠正。

column1: underline^underline the importance of 强调……的重要性|underneath^underneath the surface 在表面之下|understand^understand why 理解为何……|understanding^a better understanding of 更好地理解……
column2: Understanding what lies underneath falling sales underlines the importance of asking customers why their habits changed rather than assuming they simply want lower prices.
column3: 理解销量下降背后的原因，凸显了询问顾客习惯为何改变的重要性，而非假定他们只是想要更低价格。

column1: undertake^undertake a task 承担任务|undo^undo the damage 修复损害|undoubtedly^will undoubtedly 无疑会……|unemployment^youth unemployment 青年失业
column2: Efforts undertaken to reduce youth unemployment will undoubtedly help some graduates, but one course cannot undo years of unequal access to education.
column3: 为减少青年失业而开展的努力，无疑能帮助一些毕业生，但一门课程无法消除多年教育机会不平等造成的损害。

column1: unfold^as events unfold 随着事件发展|unfortunately^unfortunately for 对……不幸的是|uniform^a uniform standard 统一标准|unify^unify a system 统一体系
column2: Unfortunately, as events unfolded, officials discovered that unifying the system under uniform rules did not remove the need to understand local differences.
column3: 不幸的是，随着事件发展，官员发现，用统一规则整合系统，并不能免除理解地方差异的需要。

column1: union^a trade union 工会|unique^a unique opportunity 独特机会|unit^a family unit 家庭单位|unite^unite against 联合反对……
column2: The union saw a unique opportunity to unite workers whose family units faced similar pressures despite different occupations.
column3: 工会看到了一个独特机会，让职业不同、但家庭承受相似压力的劳动者团结起来。

column1: unity^a sense of unity 团结感|universal^universal access 普遍使用机会|universe^the observable universe 可观测宇宙|university^a public university 公立大学
column2: A public university can build a sense of unity by offering universal access to lectures on subjects ranging from local history to the universe.
column3: 公立大学可以向所有人开放从地方史到宇宙研究的讲座，从而建立团结感。

column1: unless^unless otherwise stated 除非另有说明|unlike^unlike before 与以前不同|unlikely^be unlikely to do 不大可能做……|unload^unload goods 卸货
column2: Unlike large retailers, small shops are unlikely to accept late deliveries unless drivers can unload goods without disturbing nearby residents.
column3: 不同于大型零售商，小商店不太可能接受深夜送货，除非司机卸货时不会打扰附近居民。

column1: until^not until 直到……才|unusual^an unusual pattern 异常模式|update^keep someone updated 使某人了解最新情况|upgrade^upgrade equipment 升级设备
column2: An unusual pattern of failures remained unnoticed until technicians updated the records and discovered that upgrades had not reached the oldest equipment.
column3: 故障的异常模式一直未被注意，直到技术员更新记录，才发现最老旧设备并未得到升级。

column1: uphold^uphold a principle 坚持原则|upright^an upright position 直立姿势|upset^be upset about 对……不安|up-to-date^up-to-date information 最新信息
column2: An up-to-date guide helped upset patients remain comfortably upright during treatment while upholding the principle that care should respect individual needs.
column3: 一份最新指南帮助不安的患者在治疗中舒适地保持直立，同时坚持照护应尊重个人需要的原则。

column1: upward^an upward trend 上升趋势|urban^urban planning 城市规划|usage^energy usage 能源使用量|useful^be useful for 对……有用
column2: Data on upward trends in energy usage are useful for urban planning only if officials can distinguish genuine growth from changes in measurement.
column3: 能源使用量上升趋势的数据，只有在官员能区分真实增长与测量变化时，才对城市规划有用。

column1: usual^as usual 像往常一样|usually^usually associated with 通常与……有关|utmost^of the utmost importance 极其重要|utter^utter failure 彻底失败
column2: Treating consultation as business as usual can lead to utter failure, even though listening is usually described as being of the utmost importance.
column3: 把咨询当作例行公事，可能导致彻底失败，尽管倾听通常被描述为极其重要。

column1: vacant^a vacant position 空缺职位|vacation^on vacation 在休假
column2: A hotel may have vacant rooms during the usual vacation season if transport problems make the destination difficult to reach.
column3: 如果交通问题使目的地难以到达，酒店即使在通常的度假季，也可能有空房。

column1: vaccine^a vaccine against 预防……的疫苗|vacuum^a policy vacuum 政策空白
column2: A policy vacuum over vaccine storage can leave local clinics uncertain about who should pay for reliable equipment and regular inspections.
column3: 疫苗储存方面的政策空白，可能让当地诊所不确定应由谁为可靠设备与定期检查付费。

column1: vague^a vague idea 模糊想法|vain^in vain 徒劳地|valuable^valuable experience 宝贵经验|vanish^vanish from 从……消失
column2: Valuable local knowledge can vanish when officials rely on vague plans, leaving residents to argue in vain for the services they need.
column3: 官员依赖模糊计划时，宝贵的本地知识可能消失，居民只能徒劳地争取所需服务。

column1: vanity^out of vanity 出于虚荣|variable^a key variable 关键变量|variance^variance in ……的差异|variation^regional variation 地区差异
column2: Choosing one flattering variable out of vanity may conceal regional variations and the variance in outcomes that matters most to households.
column3: 出于虚荣挑选一个好看的变量，可能掩盖地区差异，以及对家庭最重要的结果差别。

column1: variety^a variety of 各种各样的……|various^various factors 各种因素|vary^vary from A to B 从A到B不同|vast^a vast majority 绝大多数
column2: A variety of factors explain why outcomes vary across regions, even when the vast majority of residents express similar concerns about various public services.
column3: 多种因素可以解释地区间结果为何不同，即使绝大多数居民对各类公共服务表达了相似关切。

column1: vegetable^fresh vegetables 新鲜蔬菜|vehicle^electric vehicles 电动车
column2: Vehicles delivering fresh vegetables need efficient routes, since traffic delays can waste food long before it reaches a shop.
column3: 运送新鲜蔬菜的车辆需要高效路线，因为交通延误可能在食品到店前就造成浪费。

column1: veil^a veil of secrecy 神秘面纱|venue^a conference venue 会议场地
column2: A veil of secrecy over the choice of conference venue encouraged suspicion that private relationships mattered more than price or accessibility.
column3: 会议场地选择笼罩着神秘面纱，使人怀疑私人关系比价格或通达性更重要。

column1: verb^a phrasal verb 短语动词|verbal^verbal communication 口头交流|verse^a verse of 一节诗|version^a revised version 修订版
column2: The revised version of the textbook used familiar verses to explain verbs and show how written patterns differ from everyday verbal communication.
column3: 教材修订版借熟悉的诗句解释动词，并说明书面表达与日常口头交流的差异。

column1: vertical^vertical farming 垂直农业|viable^a viable alternative 可行替代方案|vibrate^vibrate with 因……振动|vice^a vice president 副总裁
column2: The vice president questioned whether vertical farming was commercially viable when machinery vibrated so strongly that delicate plants were damaged.
column3: 机器振动强烈、损伤娇嫩植物时，副总裁质疑垂直农业是否具有商业可行性。

column1: vicious^a vicious circle 恶性循环|victim^a victim of ……的受害者|victory^a victory over 战胜……|viewpoint^from someone's viewpoint 从某人观点看
column2: From the victims' viewpoint, breaking the vicious circle of debt would be a greater victory than receiving a small one-off payment.
column3: 从受害者的观点看，打破债务恶性循环，比获得一次性小额赔偿是更大的胜利。

column1: vigorous^vigorous debate 激烈辩论|violence^domestic violence 家庭暴力|violent^violent behaviour 暴力行为|virtual^virtual reality 虚拟现实
column2: A vigorous debate about virtual reality should distinguish discomfort with unfamiliar technology from evidence that it causes violent behaviour or real-world violence.
column3: 关于虚拟现实的激烈辩论，应区分对陌生技术的不适，以及证明它引起暴力行为或现实暴力的证据。

column1: virus^a computer virus 计算机病毒|visa^apply for a visa 申请签证|visible^be visible to 对……可见|visual^visual information 视觉信息
column2: A computer virus made visa records visible to outsiders, showing why visual warnings alone are insufficient protection for sensitive information.
column3: 计算机病毒让外部人员看到了签证记录，说明仅靠视觉警示不足以保护敏感信息。

column1: vital^be vital to 对……至关重要|vivid^a vivid account 生动叙述|vocabulary^a limited vocabulary 有限词汇|vocal^a vocal critic 直言批评者
column2: A vivid account by a vocal critic showed that technical vocabulary is not vital to explaining why public services matter.
column3: 一位直言批评者的生动叙述表明，解释公共服务为何重要，并不一定需要专业词汇。

column1: vocation^a sense of vocation 职业使命感|voice^give voice to 表达……|void^null and void 无效|volume^the volume of ……的量
column2: Teachers giving voice to a sense of vocation questioned why contracts became null and void when the volume of work fell only slightly.
column3: 教师表达职业使命感时，质问为何工作量只是略降，合同就变得无效。

column1: voluntary^on a voluntary basis 自愿地|volunteer^volunteer to do 自愿做……|vote^vote for 投票支持……|wage^a living wage 维生工资
column2: Volunteers voted for a living wage for essential staff, arguing that voluntary service should supplement paid work rather than replace it.
column3: 志愿者投票支持为必要岗位提供维生工资，认为志愿服务应补充而非取代有薪工作。

column1: wagon^a railway wagon 铁路货车车厢|waiter^a restaurant waiter 餐厅服务员|wake^in the wake of 在……之后|waken^waken someone from 将某人从……唤醒
column2: Waiters sleeping near the station were wakened by freight wagons, highlighting housing shortages in the wake of the city's tourism boom.
column3: 住在车站附近的服务员被货运车厢的声音吵醒，凸显了城市旅游繁荣之后的住房短缺。

column1: wander^wander around 闲逛|warehouse^a distribution warehouse 配送仓库|warrant^warrant attention 值得关注|warranty^under warranty 在保修期内
column2: Customers wandering through the warehouse asked whether discounted goods remained under warranty, a question warranting clearer information than the sale signs provided.
column3: 顾客在仓库里逛时，询问打折商品是否仍在保修期内；这个问题值得获得比促销标识更清晰的说明。

column1: waterproof^a waterproof jacket 防水夹克|wealth^a wealth of 大量……|wealthy^wealthy households 富裕家庭|weave^weave A into B 将A编入B
column2: Companies weaving recycled fibres into waterproof clothing can create wealth, but affordable prices matter if the benefits are not to remain limited to wealthy households.
column3: 企业把回收纤维织成防水服可以创造财富，但若不想让好处只限于富裕家庭，价格就必须合理。

column1: web^a web of 一张……的网|wedge^drive a wedge between 挑拨；造成分裂|well-known^a well-known fact 众所周知的事实|whatsoever^no reason whatsoever 毫无理由
column2: A web of misleading claims can drive a wedge between neighbors, even when there is no evidence whatsoever against a well-known local service.
column3: 一张误导性说法构成的网，可能使邻里分裂，即使完全没有证据指向一家广为人知的本地服务机构。

column1: whenever^whenever possible 只要可能|whereas^whereas others 而其他人……|whereby^a system whereby 一个借以……的系统|wherever^wherever possible 在任何可行之处
column2: A system whereby staff can work wherever suitable space is available offers flexibility, whereas fixed desks may remain necessary whenever sensitive tasks require privacy.
column3: 允许员工在有合适空间的任何地方工作的制度提供了灵活性，而敏感任务需要隐私时，固定工位仍可能必要。

column1: whichever^whichever is appropriate 无论哪个合适|while^while others 而其他人……；for a while 暂时|whoever^whoever is responsible 无论谁负责|wholesome^wholesome food 有益健康的食物
column2: Whoever chooses the menu should provide wholesome food, while allowing pupils to select whichever suitable option meets their needs.
column3: 无论由谁安排菜单，都应提供健康食品，同时让学生选择适合自身需要的选项。

column1: wicked^a wicked problem 极难解决的复杂问题|width^the width of ……的宽度|wipe^wipe out 消灭；抹去|wire^electrical wiring 电线布设；a copper wire 铜线
column2: The width of a street seems simple to measure, but fitting wires, trees and cycle lanes without wiping out walking space can become a wicked problem.
column3: 街道宽度看似容易测量，但要容纳电线、树木和自行车道，又不挤掉步行空间，可能成为极难解决的问题。

column1: wisdom^conventional wisdom 传统观念|withhold^withhold information 隐瞒信息|withstand^withstand pressure 承受压力
column2: Conventional wisdom suggests that withholding information protects confidence, but public trust often withstands bad news better than the discovery of secrecy.
column3: 传统观念认为，隐瞒信息可以维持信心，但相比发现秘密，公众信任往往更能承受坏消息。

column1: moan^moan about 抱怨……|mobile^mobile phones 手机|mobilise^mobilise support 动员支持|moderate^a moderate increase 适度增长
column2: Instead of moaning about a moderate rise in fares, residents used mobile phones to mobilise support for more reliable buses.
column3: 居民没有只是抱怨车费适度上涨，而是用手机动员公众支持改善公交可靠性。

column1: modern^modern society 现代社会|modernisation^industrial modernisation 工业现代化|modest^a modest income 不高的收入|modify^modify a plan 修改计划
column2: Modernisation plans were modified after a survey showed that modern equipment alone did little for households living on modest incomes.
column3: 调查表明，单靠现代设备几乎无益于收入不高的家庭后，现代化计划作出了调整。

column1: moist^keep moist 保持湿润|moisture^soil moisture 土壤水分
column2: Keeping soil moist after planting helps young trees survive, while covering bare ground can reduce the moisture lost during hot weather.
column3: 栽种后保持土壤湿润，有助于幼树存活，而覆盖裸地可减少炎热天气中的水分流失。

column1: moment^for the moment 暂时|momentum^gain momentum 势头增强
column2: A campaign may gain momentum at a moment of public anger, but lasting change requires an organisation that can continue after attention fades.
column3: 活动可能在公众愤怒时势头增强，但要持久改变，需要一个在关注消退后仍能继续行动的组织。

column1: monetary^monetary policy 货币政策|money^value for money 性价比|mood^be in the mood for 有心情做……|moral^a moral obligation 道德义务
column2: Monetary rewards may put workers in a better mood, but money cannot replace the moral obligation to provide safe conditions.
column3: 金钱奖励可能改善员工心情，但金钱不能替代提供安全条件的道德义务。

column1: moreover^moreover it is 而且它……|mostly^mostly because 主要因为……|motion^in motion 运转中|motive^a motive for ……的动机
column2: The reform was set in motion mostly for financial reasons; moreover, its supporters openly acknowledged that efficiency was not their only motive.
column3: 改革启动主要出于财务原因；而且，支持者公开承认效率并非唯一动机。

column1: motor^a motor vehicle 机动车|mountain^a mountain range 山脉|mourn^mourn the loss of 悼念……的逝去|movement^a social movement 社会运动
column2: After residents mourned a cyclist killed by a motor vehicle, a local movement demanded safer roads through the mountain villages.
column3: 居民悼念一名被机动车撞死的骑车者后，当地一场运动要求改善山村道路安全。

column1: multiple^multiple factors 多种因素|multiply^multiply rapidly 迅速增加|muscle^muscle strength 肌肉力量|muscular^muscular strength 肌肉力量
column2: Multiple factors influence muscular strength, so multiplying exercise sessions does not always produce equal gains in muscle growth.
column3: 多种因素影响肌肉力量，因此增加锻炼次数并不总能带来相应的肌肉增长。

column1: museum^a national museum 国家博物馆|musical^musical instruments 乐器|musician^a professional musician 职业音乐家|mute^on mute 静音状态
column2: The museum invited musicians to demonstrate traditional musical instruments after visitors complained that silent videos left the entire exhibition effectively on mute.
column3: 游客抱怨无声视频使整个展览仿佛处于静音状态后，博物馆邀请音乐家演示传统乐器。

column1: mutter^mutter under one's breath 低声嘀咕|mutual^mutual respect 相互尊重|mysterious^a mysterious disappearance 神秘失踪|mystery^solve a mystery 解开谜团
column2: Staff muttering about the mysterious disappearance of funds needed mutual respect and reliable records if they were to solve the mystery together.
column3: 员工低声议论资金神秘失踪，若要共同解开谜团，他们需要相互尊重与可靠记录。

column1: naive^be naive to do 做……是天真的|naked^the naked eye 肉眼|namely^namely that 即……|narrative^a dominant narrative 主流叙事
column2: It is naive to accept the dominant narrative, namely that only changes visible to the naked eye matter for environmental protection.
column3: 接受这样的主流说法是天真的：即只有肉眼可见的变化，才对环境保护有意义。

column1: nasty^a nasty surprise 令人不快的意外|nation^a developing nation 发展中国家|national^national identity 国家认同|native^native species 本地物种
column2: A nation promoting its natural heritage may face a nasty surprise when national parks lose native species despite growing visitor numbers.
column3: 一个宣传自然遗产的国家，可能遇到令人不快的意外：尽管游客增多，国家公园里的本地物种却在减少。

column1: natural^natural resources 自然资源|nature^the nature of ……的性质|necessary^be necessary for 对……必要|necessitate^necessitate a change 使改变成为必要
column2: The nature of water scarcity makes cooperation necessary, while protecting natural resources may necessitate changes to long-established farming practices.
column3: 缺水的性质决定了合作是必要的，而保护自然资源可能要求改变长期沿用的农业做法。

column1: negative^a negative impact 负面影响|neglect^neglect to do 疏忽未做……|negotiate^negotiate with 与……谈判|neighbor^a next-door neighbor 隔壁邻居
column2: Residents negotiating with noisy neighbors should not neglect the negative impact that prolonged disputes can have on the wider community.
column3: 居民与吵闹邻居协商时，不应忽视长期纠纷可能对整个社区产生的负面影响。

column1: neighborhood^a residential neighborhood 住宅区|nerve^lose one's nerve 失去勇气|nervous^be nervous about 对……紧张|network^a support network 支持网络
column2: A neighborhood support network can help nervous residents raise concerns without losing their nerve when faced with unfamiliar officials.
column3: 社区支持网络能帮助紧张的居民表达担忧，不至于面对陌生官员时失去勇气。

column1: neutral^remain neutral 保持中立|nevertheless^but nevertheless 但仍然|noble^a noble cause 崇高事业|noisy^a noisy environment 嘈杂环境
column2: A mediator must remain neutral even in noisy disputes over noble causes; nevertheless, neutrality should not mean ignoring unequal power.
column3: 即使围绕崇高事业展开嘈杂争论，调解者也必须保持中立；然而中立不应意味着忽视权力不平等。

column1: nominal^a nominal fee 象征性收费|nonetheless^but nonetheless 但尽管如此|nonsense^talk nonsense 胡说|norm^a social norm 社会规范
column2: The club charged only a nominal fee; nonetheless, newcomers were told it was nonsense to question the social norms that excluded them.
column3: 俱乐部只收象征性费用，但新来者质疑那些排斥自己的社会规范时，仍被说成是在胡闹。

column1: normal^under normal circumstances 通常情况下|notebook^keep a notebook 记笔记|notice^take notice of 注意到……|notorious^be notorious for 因……臭名昭著
column2: Keeping a notebook of delays helped passengers notice that a service notorious for breakdowns was unreliable even under normal circumstances.
column3: 记录延误帮助乘客发现，一个因故障频发而出名的服务，即使在正常情况下也不可靠。

column1: notwithstanding^notwithstanding the fact that 尽管……|novelty^the novelty of ……的新奇性|nowadays^nowadays many 如今许多……|nuclear^nuclear energy 核能
column2: Nowadays, interest in nuclear energy is growing, notwithstanding longstanding safety concerns; the appeal lies less in novelty than in reliable low-carbon supply.
column3: 如今，尽管长期存在安全担忧，人们对核能的兴趣仍在增长；它的吸引力更多在于可靠的低碳供给，而非新奇性。

column1: nucleus^the nucleus of ……的核心|numerous^numerous studies 大量研究|nurture^nurture talent 培养人才|nutrition^good nutrition 良好营养
column2: Numerous studies treat good nutrition as the nucleus of early development, while recognising that nurturing talent also requires emotional security.
column3: 大量研究把良好营养视为早期发展的核心，同时承认培养才能也需要情感安全。

column1: obedient^an obedient child 听话的孩子|obesity^childhood obesity 儿童肥胖|obey^obey a rule 遵守规则|objective^an objective assessment 客观评估
column2: An objective assessment of childhood obesity should examine food environments rather than merely ask whether obedient children obey advice about eating less.
column3: 客观评估儿童肥胖，应考察食物环境，而不只是询问孩子是否听话地遵守少吃的建议。

column1: obligation^have an obligation to do 有义务做……|oblige^be obliged to do 被要求做……|obscure^obscure the fact 掩盖事实|observation^direct observation 直接观察
column2: Direct observation showed that firms obliged to disclose pollution often used complex language to obscure the very obligations they claimed to fulfil.
column3: 直接观察表明，一些被要求披露污染的企业，常用复杂语言掩盖其声称正在履行的义务。

column1: obsession^an obsession with 对……的痴迷|obstacle^an obstacle to ……的障碍|obvious^an obvious reason 明显原因|occasion^on occasion 偶尔
column2: An obsession with measurable results can on occasion become an obstacle to improvement, for the obvious reason that not everything valuable is easily measured.
column3: 对可衡量结果的痴迷，有时反而会阻碍改进，原因很明显：并非所有有价值的东西都容易衡量。

column1: occur^occur to someone 某人想到……|ocean^ocean currents 洋流|odd^an odd number 奇数；an odd result 奇怪的结果|odds^against the odds 尽管困难重重
column2: Against the odds, researchers explained an odd result when it occurred to them that ocean currents could carry plastic farther than expected.
column3: 研究者克服重重困难，想到洋流可能把塑料带到比预期更远的地方，终于解释了一个奇怪结果。

column1: offensive^find something offensive 觉得某事冒犯|offer^offer an opportunity 提供机会|office^hold office 任职|officer^a police officer 警官
column2: An officer holding public office should offer clear explanations of policy rather than dismiss questions that some colleagues find offensive.
column3: 担任公职的官员，应清楚解释政策，而非因某些同事觉得问题冒犯就不予理会。

column1: official^an official statement 官方声明|offset^offset the cost 抵消成本
column2: An official report questioned whether promised energy savings would offset the environmental cost of constructing another large public building.
column3: 一份官方报告质疑，承诺的节能收益是否能够抵消再建一座大型公共建筑的环境成本。

column1: offspring^produce offspring 繁殖后代
column2: Birds may produce fewer offspring when construction removes the quiet places where they nest, even if food remains plentiful nearby.
column3: 施工移除了安静筑巢地时，即使附近食物仍充足，鸟类也可能繁殖更少后代。

column1: opera^an opera house 歌剧院
column2: Opening the opera house to school groups can broaden access to music without requiring families to buy expensive tickets for every child.
column3: 向学校团体开放歌剧院，可以扩大音乐接触机会，而不必让家庭为每个孩子购买昂贵门票。

column1: operate^operate a business 经营企业|operational^operational costs 运营成本|operator^a transport operator 交通运营商|opinion^in someone's opinion 在某人看来
column2: In the operator's opinion, keeping buses operational in remote villages was more important than operating every route at a profit.
column3: 在运营商看来，让偏远村庄的公交保持运行，比每条线路都盈利更重要。

column1: opponent^a political opponent 政治对手|opportunity^equal opportunities 平等机会|oppose^oppose a proposal 反对提议|opposite^the opposite of ……的反面
column2: Opponents opposed the proposal because it would do the opposite of creating equal opportunities by giving already wealthy families more support.
column3: 提案反对者认为，给已经富裕的家庭更多支持，会产生与创造平等机会相反的结果。

column1: oppress^oppress a minority 压迫少数群体|option^have no option but to do 别无选择只能做……
column2: People oppressed by unfair working conditions need realistic options for change, not simply advice to be more confident when speaking to managers.
column3: 受到不公平工作条件压迫的人，需要切实可行的改变选择，而不只是被建议与经理交谈时更自信。

column1: optical^an optical illusion 视觉错觉|optimistic^be optimistic about 对……乐观
column2: Like an optical illusion, an optimistic chart can mislead viewers if its design makes a small improvement appear much larger than it is.
column3: 就像视觉错觉，一张乐观的图表，如果通过设计把微小改善显得远大于实际，就会误导观看者。

column1: optional^an optional course 选修课程|order^in order to 为了……|orderly^an orderly process 有序流程|ordinary^ordinary people 普通人
column2: An optional course on public decision-making can help ordinary people understand why an orderly process matters in order to protect everyone's voice.
column3: 一门公共决策选修课，可以帮助普通人理解：为什么保障每个人发声需要有序流程。

column1: organ^organ donation 器官捐献|organization^a non-profit organization 非营利组织
column2: A non-profit organization promoting organ donation must explain clearly how consent is obtained and how donated organs are allocated.
column3: 一家推广器官捐献的非营利组织，必须清楚解释如何获得同意、以及捐献器官如何分配。

column1: organic^organic farming 有机农业|organise^organise an event 组织活动
column2: Schools organising visits to organic farms can help children understand where food comes from without presenting one farming method as a perfect solution.
column3: 学校组织参观有机农场，可以帮助儿童理解食物来源，而不把某一种耕作方式说成完美答案。

column1: organism^a living organism 生物体|origin^the origin of ……的起源|original^the original intention 初衷|otherwise^otherwise known as 亦称为；否则
column2: Research into the origins of living organisms may reveal processes otherwise hidden, even when such discoveries go beyond the original intention of the study.
column3: 探索生物体起源的研究，可能揭示原本不为人知的过程，即使这些发现超出了研究初衷。

column1: ought to^ought to 应当|outbreak^an outbreak of ……的暴发|outcome^a possible outcome 可能结果|outdoor^outdoor activities 户外活动
column2: Officials ought to consider outdoor activities during a disease outbreak, comparing possible outcomes rather than assuming that every gathering carries the same risk.
column3: 疾病暴发期间，官员应考虑户外活动并比较可能结果，而非假定每种聚集都具有相同风险。

column1: outer^the outer edge 外缘|outlook^a long-term outlook 长远前景|output^industrial output 工业产出|outset^from the outset 从一开始
column2: From the outset, the factory's location on the city's outer edge shaped both its output costs and its long-term outlook.
column3: 从一开始，工厂位于城市外缘这一位置，就影响了其生产成本与长远前景。

column1: outstanding^outstanding performance 出色表现|outward^outward appearance 外观|overall^the overall effect 总体效果|overcome^overcome an obstacle 克服障碍
column2: Outstanding outward appearance does not reveal whether a building overcomes barriers to access or what its overall effect is on everyday users.
column3: 建筑出众的外观，并不能说明它是否克服了无障碍使用的障碍，也不能说明它对日常使用者的总体影响。

column1: overhead^overhead costs 间接费用|overhear^overhear a conversation 无意听到谈话|overlap^overlap with 与……重叠|overnight^overnight success 一夜成名
column2: An overheard conversation revealed that overlapping responsibilities and high overhead costs had been hidden behind the firm's story of overnight success.
column3: 一段无意听到的谈话揭示，职责重叠与高额管理费用，一直被公司的“一夜成功”故事掩盖。

column1: overtake^overtake a rival 超过对手|owe^owe A to B 把A归功于B；欠B以A|own^on one's own 独立地|owner^a business owner 企业主
column2: Business owners who overtake larger rivals rarely succeed entirely on their own; they often owe much to public infrastructure and earlier research.
column3: 超过大对手的企业主，很少完全独立取得成功；他们往往在很大程度上受益于公共基础设施与先前研究。

column1: pace^keep pace with 跟上……|pack^pack into 挤进；装进|package^a package deal 一揽子交易|packet^a packet of 一包……
column2: As packaging technology kept pace with demand, manufacturers packed smaller portions into individual packets, making convenience a growing source of waste.
column3: 包装技术跟上需求时，制造商把更小份量装入独立小包，使便利成为日益突出的垃圾来源。

column1: pact^sign a pact 签订协定|pain^take pains to do 费心做……|painful^a painful decision 痛苦决定|paint^paint a picture of 描绘……
column2: Negotiators took pains to paint a realistic picture of the painful decisions required before countries could sign an effective climate pact.
column3: 谈判者费心如实描绘，在各国签署有效气候协定之前，需要作出哪些痛苦决定。

column1: painting^a landscape painting 风景画|panel^a panel of experts 专家小组|panic^in a panic 惊慌地|parade^a public parade 公开游行
column2: A panel of experts urged calm after panic spread over paintings damaged during a parade, explaining that restoration was still possible.
column3: 游行中画作受损引发恐慌后，专家小组呼吁冷静，解释说修复仍然可能。

column1: paradigm^a paradigm shift 范式转变|paradise^a tourist paradise 旅游天堂|paragraph^the opening paragraph 开头段|paralyse^paralyse a system 使系统瘫痪
column2: The opening paragraph challenged the island's image as a tourist paradise, describing a transport crisis that had paralysed daily life and prompted a paradigm shift.
column3: 开头段质疑了该岛作为旅游天堂的形象，描写了令日常生活瘫痪、并促使观念转变的交通危机。

column1: parcel^a parcel of land 一块土地；a parcel delivery 包裹投递|parliament^a member of parliament 议员
column2: Members of parliament questioned a parcel delivery company about repeated losses, asking why customers found it so difficult to obtain compensation.
column3: 议员就反复丢件质问一家包裹配送公司，询问顾客为什么如此难以获得赔偿。

column1: pardon^beg someone's pardon 请原谅|partial^a partial explanation 部分解释
column2: A request for pardon deserves more than a partial examination of the evidence, particularly when the original decision has serious consequences for a family.
column3: 请求赦免，应得到超越局部证据的审查，尤其当原判对一个家庭有严重后果时。

column1: participate^participate in 参加……|particular^in particular 尤其|partly^partly because 部分因为……|partner^a business partner 商业伙伴
column2: Small firms participate less in training partly because business partners rarely share the costs, a problem that affects rural employers in particular.
column3: 小企业较少参与培训，部分原因是商业伙伴很少分担成本，这个问题尤其影响乡村雇主。

column1: passage^the passage of time 时间流逝|passenger^a rail passenger 铁路乘客|passerby^a passerby stopped 一名路人停下|passion^a passion for 对……的热爱
column2: Passengers rushing through the narrow passage rarely noticed the mural until a passerby with a passion for local history began explaining its story.
column3: 乘客匆忙穿过狭窄通道，很少注意到壁画，直到一名热爱地方历史的路人开始讲述其故事。

column1: passive^a passive role 被动角色|paste^copy and paste 复制粘贴|pastime^a popular pastime 流行消遣|pasture^green pastures 绿草地；new pastures 新天地
column2: Online travel has become a popular pastime, but copying and pasting images of green pastures leaves viewers in a passive role rather than encouraging real exploration.
column3: 线上旅行成了流行消遣，但复制粘贴绿草地图片，让观看者处于被动角色，而非鼓励真正探索。

column1: patent^apply for a patent 申请专利|path^a career path 职业道路|pathetic^a pathetic excuse 可悲的借口|patience^have patience with 耐心对待……
column2: Inventors need patience on the path to obtaining a patent, but administrative delay is a pathetic excuse for failing to protect genuinely new ideas.
column3: 发明者在取得专利的道路上需要耐心，但行政拖延不能成为未能保护真正新想法的可悲借口。

column1: patient^be patient with 耐心对待……；a hospital patient 住院病人|pattern^a pattern of ……的模式|pause^pause to do 停下来做……|pave^pave the way for 为……铺路
column2: Doctors who pause to listen to patients may notice patterns that pave the way for more effective treatment.
column3: 医生停下来倾听患者时，可能发现为更有效治疗铺路的规律。

column1: pavement^on the pavement 在人行道上|pay^pay attention to 注意……|payment^make a payment 付款|peace^peace of mind 安心
column2: Cashless payments for pavement parking offer convenience, but drivers pay for peace of mind only if the system reliably records each payment.
column3: 人行道边停车采用无现金付款很方便，但只有系统可靠记录每笔款项，驾驶者花钱后才能安心。

column1: peaceful^peaceful coexistence 和平共处|peak^at its peak 在高峰期|peculiar^be peculiar to 为……特有|penetrate^penetrate a market 进入市场
column2: At its peak, the campaign sought peaceful coexistence between tourism and wildlife, protecting habitats peculiar to species that cannot move when development penetrates their territory.
column3: 活动最盛时，目标是让旅游与野生动物和平共处，保护那些开发侵入领地时无法迁离的物种所特有的栖息地。

column1: percent^ten percent 百分之十|percentage^a small percentage of ……的一小部分|perfect^a perfect example 完美例子|perform^perform a task 执行任务
column2: A system may perform without error in ninety percent of cases, but perfect safety is not guaranteed if the remaining percentage involves serious risks to life.
column3: 一个系统在百分之九十的情况下可以无误运行，但如果剩余部分涉及严重生命风险，就不能保证完全安全。

column1: performance^job performance 工作表现|period^over a period of 在……期间|periodical^a scientific periodical 科学期刊|perish^perish in 死于……
column2: A scientific periodical examined how safety performance changed over a period in which several workers perished in preventable accidents.
column3: 一本科学期刊考察了数名工人死于可预防事故的那段时期，安全表现发生了怎样的变化。

column1: permanent^a permanent job 长期工作|permeate^permeate society 遍及社会|permission^ask for permission 请求许可|permit^permit someone to do 允许某人做……
column2: When insecurity permeates the workplace, even permanent employees may feel they need permission to take breaks that the rules already permit.
column3: 不安全感弥漫职场时，即使长期员工也可能觉得，进行规则已允许的休息还需要另行许可。

column1: perpetual^perpetual change 持续变化|perplex^be perplexed by 对……困惑|persecute^be persecuted for 因……受迫害|persevere^persevere in 坚持……
column2: People perplexed by perpetual criticism should persevere in asking questions, particularly when dissenters have historically been persecuted for challenging accepted ideas.
column3: 对持续批评感到困惑的人，仍应坚持提问，尤其考虑到历史上异议者曾因挑战公认观念遭到迫害。

column1: persist^persist in 坚持……|personal^personal information 个人信息|personality^personality traits 性格特征|personnel^personnel management 人事管理
column2: Personnel departments should not persist in treating personality scores as complete descriptions of people or collect more personal information than necessary.
column3: 人事部门不应坚持把性格评分当作人的完整描述，也不应收集超出必要范围的个人信息。

column1: perspective^from a different perspective 从不同角度|persuade^persuade someone to do 说服某人做……|petroleum^petroleum products 石油产品|petty^petty disputes 小纠纷
column2: Seen from an environmental perspective, petty disputes over labels should not distract consumers from efforts to persuade firms to reduce petroleum-based packaging.
column3: 从环境角度看，标签上的小纠纷不应让消费者忽视说服企业减少石油基包装的努力。

column1: pharmacy^a local pharmacy 当地药房|phase^phase out 逐步淘汰|phenomenon^a common phenomenon 常见现象|photograph^an aerial photograph 航拍照片
column2: Photographs of closed pharmacies illustrate a wider phenomenon: essential services being phased out of areas with declining populations.
column3: 关门药房的照片揭示一种更广泛现象：人口减少地区的基本服务正在逐步退出。

column1: phrase^a common phrase 常用短语|physical^physical activity 身体活动|pickup^a pickup point 提货点|pilgrim^a pilgrim route 朝圣路线
column2: The phrase active travel covers physical journeys as varied as walking to a parcel pickup point and following an ancient pilgrim route.
column3: “积极出行”这一说法涵盖各种身体活动式的旅程，从步行到包裹提货点，到沿古老朝圣路线行走。

column1: pioneer^pioneer a method 开创方法|pillar^a pillar of ……的支柱|pirate^pirate a book 盗版一本书
column2: A publisher pioneering affordable books saw libraries as a pillar of learning, arguing that legal access could reduce the incentive to pirate expensive texts.
column3: 一家开创平价图书的出版社，把图书馆视为学习支柱，认为合法获取可以减少盗版昂贵书籍的动机。

column1: pint^a pint of 一品脱……
column2: The price of a pint of milk matters to household budgets, especially when small daily increases add up over several months.
column3: 一品脱牛奶的价格关系到家庭预算，尤其是每天小幅涨价持续数月、累积成较大开销时。

column1: pistol^a starting pistol 发令枪|pitch^a sales pitch 推销说辞；a football pitch 足球场|plain^plain language 通俗语言|planet^protect the planet 保护地球
column2: A starting pistol opened the charity race, while a plain-language pitch explained how donations would support projects protecting the planet.
column3: 发令枪开启慈善赛跑，同时一段通俗易懂的宣传说明了捐款将如何支持保护地球的项目。

column1: plant^a power plant 发电厂|plaster^a plaster cast 石膏模型|plastic^single-use plastic 一次性塑料|platform^an online platform 网络平台
column2: An online platform helped workshops reuse plastic and plaster left over from construction near a power plant.
column3: 一个网络平台帮助作坊回收利用发电厂附近施工剩下的塑料与石膏。

column1: plausible^a plausible explanation 看似合理的解释|pleasant^a pleasant experience 愉快体验|pleasure^take pleasure in 乐于……|pledge^pledge to do 承诺做……
column2: A company may pledge a pleasant shopping experience, but customers take little pleasure in explanations that sound plausible yet fail to resolve repeated faults.
column3: 公司可能承诺提供愉快购物体验，但那些听似合理、却不能解决反复故障的解释，很难让顾客高兴。

column1: plentiful^a plentiful supply 充足供应|plenty^plenty of 大量……|plug^plug a gap 填补缺口|pocket^out of pocket 自掏腰包；损失钱财
column2: Although grants were plentiful, volunteers still paid out of pocket to plug gaps in services that officials claimed already had plenty of support.
column3: 尽管资助不少，志愿者仍自掏腰包填补服务缺口，而官员声称这些服务已经获得充分支持。

column1: poem^a poem about 关于……的诗|poet^a contemporary poet 当代诗人|poetry^a collection of poetry 诗集|poison^poison the atmosphere 破坏气氛
column2: A poet used poems about industrial life to show how polluted air could poison a neighborhood's atmosphere, turning poetry into social criticism.
column3: 一位诗人描写工业生活的诗集，展示了受污染空气如何既毒化社区环境，也侵蚀居民的希望。

column1: polar^polar regions 极地地区|pole^the North Pole 北极|policy^public policy 公共政策|polish^polish a skill 磨练技能
column2: Researchers polishing their communication skills explained why public policy on polar regions must consider changes far beyond the North Pole.
column3: 磨练沟通技能的研究者解释，为什么极地公共政策必须考虑远超北极范围的变化。

column1: polite^be polite to 对……有礼貌|political^political participation 政治参与|politician^an elected politician 民选政治人物|politics^local politics 地方政治
column2: Polite exchanges with politicians are valuable, but meaningful political participation in local politics also requires opportunities to challenge decisions.
column3: 与政治人物礼貌交流很有价值，但有意义的地方政治参与，也需要质疑决定的机会。

column1: pollute^pollute the environment 污染环境|pollution^air pollution 空气污染|pond^a garden pond 花园池塘|ponder^ponder a question 深思问题
column2: Watching pollution spread through a small pond prompted students to ponder how everyday choices can pollute environments far from where products are used.
column3: 看着污染在小池塘扩散，促使学生思考：日常选择如何污染那些远离产品使用地的环境。

column1: popular^be popular with 受……欢迎|population^an ageing population 老龄化人口|porcelain^fine porcelain 精美瓷器|portable^a portable device 便携设备
column2: Portable displays made a porcelain exhibition popular with an ageing population who found it difficult to stand beside traditional museum cases.
column3: 便携展示设备使瓷器展受到老年人群欢迎，他们难以长时间站在传统展柜旁。

column1: portrait^a portrait of ……的画像；描写|portray^portray A as B 把A描绘成B|pose^pose a threat 构成威胁|position^be in a position to do 能够做……
column2: A report portrayed older workers as posing a threat to productivity, a misleading portrait of people well positioned to train younger colleagues.
column3: 一份把老年员工描绘为生产率威胁的报告，错误呈现了这些往往很适合培训年轻同事的人。

column1: positive^a positive attitude 积极态度|possibility^the possibility of ……的可能性|possible^as far as possible 尽可能|post^a job post 职位；post online 网上发布
column2: Posting positive stories online can widen the possibility of recruitment, but employers should make working conditions as clear as possible.
column3: 在网上发布积极故事，可能扩大招聘机会，但雇主应尽可能把工作条件讲清楚。

column1: postage^postage costs 邮费|postpone^postpone doing 推迟做……
column2: Rising postage costs led the charity to postpone sending printed newsletters while it asked members whether digital copies would meet their needs.
column3: 邮费上涨使慈善机构推迟寄出纸质通讯，同时询问会员电子版本是否能满足需要。

column1: posture^a sitting posture 坐姿|potential^potential benefits 潜在好处
column2: The potential benefits of remote work should be weighed against health problems that may arise when employees sit in an uncomfortable posture for hours.
column3: 权衡远程工作的潜在好处时，也应考虑员工长时间保持不舒适坐姿可能产生的健康问题。

column1: pound^pound the pavement 奔走求职；a pound of 一磅……|power^purchasing power 购买力|powerful^a powerful influence 强大影响|practical^practical experience 实践经验
column2: Falling purchasing power has a powerful influence on graduates pounding the pavement for work, making practical experience more valuable than promises of quick success.
column3: 购买力下降强烈影响着奔走求职的毕业生，使实践经验比快速成功的承诺更有价值。

column1: practice^in practice 实际上|precaution^take precautions 采取预防措施|precede^be preceded by 在……之前有|precedent^set a precedent 开创先例
column2: In practice, major reforms should be preceded by consultation and reasonable precautions, setting a precedent for decisions that affect vulnerable groups.
column3: 实际上，重大改革前应先咨询并采取合理预防措施，为影响脆弱群体的决策树立先例。

column1: preceding^the preceding year 前一年|precious^precious resources 宝贵资源|precise^a precise estimate 精确估计|predict^predict the future 预测未来
column2: A precise estimate based on the preceding year cannot predict every future shortage, but it can help protect precious resources from waste.
column3: 基于前一年的精确估计，无法预测未来每次短缺，却能帮助避免宝贵资源浪费。

column1: predominant^the predominant view 主流观点|preface^in the preface 在序言中|preferable^be preferable to 比……更可取|preference^a preference for 对……的偏好
column2: In the preface, the author questions the predominant preference for constant expansion, arguing that stability may sometimes be preferable to growth.
column3: 作者在序言中质疑普遍偏好不断扩张的观点，认为稳定有时可能比增长更可取。

column1: pregnant^pregnant women 孕妇|pretext^on the pretext of 以……为借口|prevail^prevail over 战胜……|previous^previous experience 以往经验
column2: Employers should not exclude pregnant applicants on the pretext of protecting them; equal treatment must prevail over assumptions based on previous practice.
column3: 雇主不应以保护为借口排除怀孕的求职者；平等待遇必须优先于基于旧做法的假设。

column1: price^at the price of 以……为代价|pride^take pride in 为……自豪|primary^a primary concern 首要关切|prime^a prime example 典型例子
column2: A town taking pride in cheap production is a prime example of why price should not become the primary concern when workers bear hidden costs.
column3: 一座以廉价生产为傲的小镇，是一个典型例子，说明工人承受隐藏代价时，不应把价格当成首要关切。

column1: primitive^primitive tools 原始工具|principal^a principal reason 主要原因|principle^in principle 原则上|print^in print 已出版；付印
column2: A book in print explains that the principal value of primitive tools lies in what they reveal about the principles guiding early human choices.
column3: 一本已出版的书解释，原始工具的主要价值，在于揭示指导早期人类选择的原则。

column1: prior^prior to 在……之前|privacy^privacy protection 隐私保护|private^private information 私人信息|prize^a Nobel Prize 诺贝尔奖
column2: Prior to awarding the prize, the committee examined whether the research had respected privacy and protected participants' private information.
column3: 颁奖之前，委员会考察了研究是否尊重隐私，并保护了参与者的私人信息。

column1: probability^the probability of ……的概率|probable^the most probable 最可能的……|problem^a potential problem 潜在问题|procedure^a standard procedure 标准流程
column2: A standard procedure should address the most probable problems without ignoring low-probability failures that could have severe consequences.
column3: 标准流程应处理最可能出现的问题，同时不忽视那些概率低、后果却可能严重的故障。

column1: proceedings^legal proceedings 法律诉讼|process^a decision-making process 决策过程|procession^a funeral procession 葬礼队伍|proclaim^proclaim victory 宣布胜利
column2: Legal proceedings followed the disruption of a funeral procession, and officials were warned not to proclaim victory before the judicial process was complete.
column3: 葬礼队伍受阻后引发了法律诉讼，官员受到提醒：司法程序完成前，不应宣布胜利。

column1: produce^produce evidence 提供证据|product^a finished product 成品|production^mass production 大规模生产|productive^productive use 有效利用
column2: Mass production can make products cheaper, but firms must produce evidence that resources are put to productive use throughout the manufacturing process.
column3: 大规模生产可以让产品更便宜，但企业必须提供证据，证明资源在整个制造流程中得到有效利用。

column1: productivity^labour productivity 劳动生产率|profession^enter a profession 进入某职业|professional^professional development 职业发展|professor^a university professor 大学教授
column2: A professor studying the teaching profession argued that professional development should improve learning rather than merely raise narrowly measured productivity.
column3: 一位研究教师职业的教授认为，职业发展应改善学习，而非只提高狭义指标衡量的生产率。

column1: profile^a public profile 公众形象|profit^make a profit 盈利|profitable^a profitable business 盈利企业|program^a training program 培训计划
column2: A profitable firm raised its public profile with a training program, but its real contribution depended on whether trainees gained lasting benefits beyond company profits.
column3: 一家盈利企业通过培训计划提高了知名度，但其真正贡献，取决于受训者能否在公司利润之外获得持久收益。

column1: progress^make progress 取得进展|prohibit^prohibit someone from doing 禁止某人做……|project^a research project 研究项目|prolong^prolong a delay 延长拖延
column2: The research project made little progress because rules prohibiting data sharing prolonged delays that better safeguards might have avoided.
column3: 研究项目进展甚微，因为禁止数据共享的规则延长了拖延，而更好的保护措施本可能避免这些问题。

column1: prominent^a prominent role 重要作用|promise^keep a promise 信守承诺|prompt^a prompt response 迅速回应|pronounce^pronounce a word 给单词发音；pronounce on 对……发表意见
column2: Prominent commentators should resist pronouncing on complex disputes too quickly, even when their audiences expect a prompt response to every broken promise.
column3: 知名评论者应避免过快对复杂争议下结论，即使受众期待他们对每个失信事件都迅速回应。

column1: proof^proof of ……的证据|propaganda^political propaganda 政治宣传|propagate^propagate an idea 传播观念|proper^proper procedures 正当程序
column2: Proper procedures require proof, whereas propaganda can propagate an attractive idea without showing that it works in practice.
column3: 正当程序需要证据，而宣传可以传播一个动人的想法，却不展示它在实际中是否有效。

column1: property^property rights 财产权|proposal^a proposal for 关于……的提案|propose^propose doing 提议做……|prosecute^prosecute someone for 因……起诉某人
column2: A proposal to protect property rights included prosecuting landlords who illegally evicted tenants, but critics proposed stronger preventive measures as well.
column3: 一份保护财产权的提案包括起诉非法驱逐租户的房东，但批评者还提出了更强的预防措施。

column1: prospect^job prospects 就业前景|prosper^prosper in 在……中兴旺|prosperity^shared prosperity 共同繁荣|protect^protect A from B 保护A免受B影响
column2: An economy prospers when better job prospects protect families from insecurity, yet rising output alone does not guarantee shared prosperity.
column3: 更好的就业前景保护家庭免受不稳定影响时，经济才真正兴旺；但仅有产出增长，并不保证共同繁荣。

column1: protein^a source of protein 蛋白质来源|protest^a protest against 对……的抗议|provide^provide someone with 向某人提供……|provision^make provision for 为……作安排
column2: Protests over school meals led the council to provide better sources of protein and make provision for children with special dietary needs.
column3: 围绕学校餐食的抗议，促使市政委员会提供更好的蛋白质来源，并为有特殊饮食需求的儿童作出安排。

column1: provoke^provoke a debate 引发争论|proximate^a proximate cause 直接原因|prudent^a prudent approach 审慎方法|public^in the public interest 为公众利益
column2: A prudent public inquiry must examine more than the proximate cause of a disaster, even if broader questions provoke uncomfortable debate.
column3: 审慎的公共调查必须考察灾难直接原因之外的问题，即使更广泛的问题会引发令人不安的争论。

column1: publish^publish findings 发表研究结果|punctual^be punctual for 准时参加……|punish^punish someone for 因……惩罚某人|pure^pure chance 纯属偶然
column2: Published findings questioned whether punishing every late arrival produced punctual workers or merely rewarded those whose journeys were reliable by pure chance.
column3: 已发表的研究结果质疑，惩罚每次迟到，究竟培养了守时员工，还是只是奖励了那些纯因偶然而通勤可靠的人。

column1: purify^purify water 净化水|purpose^for the purpose of 为了……|purse^the public purse 公共财政|pursue^pursue a goal 追求目标
column2: Pursuing cleaner water serves a public purpose, but choosing how to purify it requires balancing health benefits against demands on the public purse.
column3: 追求更洁净的水服务于公共目标，但选择净水方式，需要权衡健康收益与公共财政负担。

column1: qualify^qualify for 有资格获得……|quality^quality of life 生活质量|quantify^quantify the impact 量化影响|quantity^a large quantity of 大量……
column2: Quantifying the quantity of services supplied says little about quality of life if many residents do not qualify for the support they need.
column3: 如果许多居民不符合所需支持的资格，仅仅量化服务供给的数量，并不能充分说明生活质量。

column1: quest^a quest for 对……的追求|question^call into question 对……提出质疑|questionnaire^a questionnaire survey 问卷调查|quiet^a quiet place 安静地方
column2: A questionnaire asking about quiet places called into question the assumption that the quest for urban convenience always improves daily life.
column3: 一份询问安静场所的问卷，对“追求城市便利总能改善日常生活”的假设提出了质疑。

column1: quit^quit a job 辞职|quiz^a short quiz 简短测验|radiate^radiate heat 散热|rage^public rage 公众愤怒
column2: Public rage grew when workers quit a factory where machines radiated intense heat, despite a safety quiz claiming that everyone understood the risks.
column3: 一家工厂的机器散发高温，工人纷纷离职；尽管安全测验声称人人都了解风险，公众愤怒仍不断增长。

column1: raid^a police raid 警方突查|rail^rail transport 铁路运输|railway^a railway station 火车站|range^a range of 一系列……
column2: A raid near the railway station exposed a range of stolen goods, raising questions about security along the rail network.
column3: 火车站附近的一次突查发现了一系列赃物，引发了对铁路网络沿线安全的质疑。

column1: rank^rank among 位列……|rapid^rapid growth 快速增长|rare^a rare opportunity 难得机会|rarely^rarely seen 罕见的
column2: Cities experiencing rapid growth rarely rank highly on every measure of well-being, offering a rare opportunity to question what growth alone achieves.
column3: 快速发展的城市，很少在所有福祉指标上都排名靠前，这为质疑单纯增长的成效提供了难得机会。

column1: rate^at a rate of 以……的速度|rational^a rational choice 理性选择|raw^raw data 原始数据|react^react to 对……作出反应
column2: How people react to interest rates may seem irrational until researchers examine raw data on the financial constraints shaping apparently rational choices.
column3: 人们对利率的反应看似不理性，直到研究者检查财务约束的原始数据，才发现这些约束如何塑造了看似理性的选择。

column1: readily^readily available 容易获得的|realistic^a realistic expectation 现实的期望|reality^in reality 实际上|realm^the realm of ……的领域
