column2: In reality, information that is readily available in the realm of science is not always easy for the public to interpret, making realistic expectations essential.
column3: 实际上，科学领域容易获得的信息，并不总容易为公众解读，因此现实的期望至关重要。

column1: reasonable^a reasonable explanation 合理解释|reassure^reassure someone that 向某人保证……|recall^recall a product 召回产品；recall doing 回忆做过……|recede^recede into 逐渐淡出……
column2: A product recall needs a reasonable explanation that reassures customers, rather than waiting for public concern to recede into the background.
column3: 产品召回需要合理解释来安抚顾客，而非等待公众担忧逐渐淡出视线。

column1: receive^receive support 获得支持|recent^in recent years 近年来|recite^recite from memory 凭记忆背诵|reckon^reckon that 认为……
column2: Teachers receiving new guidance in recent years reckon that explaining a concept matters more than reciting its definition from memory.
column3: 近年来获得新指导的教师认为，解释一个概念，比凭记忆背诵它的定义更重要。

column1: reclaim^reclaim land 开垦土地；reclaim control 收回控制权|recollect^recollect doing 回忆做过……|recommend^recommend doing 建议做……|record^keep a record 记录
column2: Residents who recollected playing on the riverbank recommended reclaiming it as public space, using old records to support their case.
column3: 回忆起曾在河岸玩耍的居民，建议将其重新收回为公共空间，并用旧记录支持这一主张。

column1: recover^recover from 从……恢复|recovery^an economic recovery 经济复苏|rectangle^a rectangle of 一块长方形的……|rectify^rectify an error 纠正错误
column2: Restoring a rectangle of damaged wetland helped wildlife recover, but economic recovery also required rectifying the planning errors that had caused the damage.
column3: 恢复一块长方形的受损湿地，帮助野生动物恢复，但经济复苏也需要纠正造成破坏的规划错误。

column1: recur^recur at intervals 每隔一段时间复发|recycle^recycle waste 回收废物|reduce^reduce waste 减少浪费|reel^a reel of 一卷……
column2: Recycling reels of packaging film can reduce waste, but the problem will recur unless manufacturers also redesign the products that generate it.
column3: 回收成卷的包装膜可以减少废物，但如果制造商不同时重新设计产生废物的产品，问题仍会重现。

column1: refer^refer to 提到；指的是|reference^with reference to 关于……|refine^refine a method 改进方法|reform^economic reform 经济改革
column2: With reference to earlier reforms, the report referred to evidence showing why evaluation methods needed refining before new targets were introduced.
column3: 报告谈及先前改革时，引用证据说明，为什么引入新目标前需要改进评估方法。

column1: refrain^refrain from 克制不做……|refresh^refresh one's memory 唤起记忆|refund^a full refund 全额退款|refuse^refuse to do 拒绝做……
column2: Before refusing a refund, staff should refresh their memory of the policy and refrain from assuming that every complaint is unreasonable.
column3: 拒绝退款之前，员工应重新回顾政策，并避免假定每项投诉都不合理。

column1: regarding^regarding the issue of 关于……的问题|regardless^regardless of 不论……|register^register for 报名参加……|regret^regret doing 后悔做过……
column2: Regardless of income, residents could register for the meeting regarding new housing, although some regretted not receiving enough notice.
column3: 不论收入，居民都可以报名参加有关新住房的会议，但有些人遗憾没有更早收到通知。

column1: regulate^regulate the market 监管市场|regulation^government regulation 政府监管|reign^during the reign of 在……统治时期|rein^rein in 约束；控制
column2: During the mayor's reign, regulations intended to rein in unsafe lending failed because the agencies regulating the market lacked staff.
column3: 市长任内，旨在遏制不安全放贷的规定未能奏效，因为监管市场的机构人手不足。

column1: relation^in relation to 关于；相对于|relationship^a relationship between ……之间的关系|relative^relative to 相对于|relax^relax restrictions 放宽限制
column2: The relationship between public trust and safety matters when officials consider relaxing restrictions in relation to risks that are low relative to everyday alternatives.
column3: 官员考虑针对相对日常替代方案风险较低的活动放宽限制时，公众信任与安全之间的关系很重要。

column1: relevant^be relevant to 与……相关|relief^a sense of relief 如释重负|relieve^relieve pressure 缓解压力|religion^freedom of religion 宗教自由
column2: Relieving financial pressure brought a sense of relief to families, while support relevant to their needs also respected differences in language and religion.
column3: 缓解经济压力让家庭如释重负，而符合其需要的支持，也尊重了语言和宗教差异。

column1: religious^religious beliefs 宗教信仰|remain^remain to be seen 尚待观察|remark^remark on 评论……|remedy^a remedy for ……的补救办法
column2: It remains to be seen whether the proposed remedy respects religious beliefs, observers remarked after examining the new community rules.
column3: 观察者检查新的社区规则后评论说，拟议的补救办法是否尊重宗教信仰，仍有待观察。

column1: remember^remember to do 记得去做……|remind^remind someone of 使某人想起……|removal^the removal of ……的移除|remove^remove a barrier 消除障碍
column2: Removing physical barriers is important, but planners must remember to consult users who remind them that the removal of obstacles also involves attitudes.
column3: 消除实体障碍很重要，但规划者必须记得咨询使用者，他们会提醒规划者：消除障碍也涉及态度改变。

column1: render^render something useless 使某物无用|renew^renew a contract 续签合同|rent^pay rent 付租金|repair^beyond repair 无法修复
column2: A tenant asked to renew the lease after repairs had rendered a previously unusable flat safe, but feared that higher rent would force her out.
column3: 维修让原本无法使用的公寓变得安全后，一位租户要求续租，却担心涨租会迫使自己搬走。

column1: repay^repay a loan 偿还贷款|reply^in reply to 回复……
column2: In reply to complaints about loan repayments, the bank explained how customers could repay smaller amounts temporarily without ignoring the debt altogether.
column3: 银行回应还款投诉时，解释了顾客如何暂时减少偿还金额，而不是完全置债务于不顾。

column1: repel^repel insects 驱虫|repeat^repeat a mistake 重蹈覆辙
column2: Repeating the same chemical treatment may fail to repel insects if farmers do not examine why earlier attempts produced only temporary results.
column3: 如果农民不检查先前尝试为何只产生暂时效果，重复同一种化学处理可能无法驱虫。

column1: report^according to a report 据报告|represent^represent the interests of 代表……的利益|reproach^beyond reproach 无可指责|reproduce^reproduce a result 重现结果
column2: A report representing community interests still needs scrutiny; being able to reproduce results is useful evidence, not proof that it is beyond reproach.
column3: 代表社区利益的报告仍需审查；能够重现结果是有用证据，却不能证明它无可指责。

column1: republic^a democratic republic 民主共和国|request^at someone's request 应某人要求|require^require someone to do 要求某人做……|rescue^rescue operations 救援行动
column2: At residents' request, the republic's officials required rescue agencies to publish clear information about how emergency assistance was allocated.
column3: 应居民要求，该共和国官员要求救援机构公布清晰信息，说明紧急援助如何分配。

column1: research^research into 对……的研究|resent^resent doing 不满于做……|residence^a permanent residence 永久住所|resign^resign from 辞去……
column2: Research into staff turnover found that employees resented moving residence repeatedly, leading some to resign from otherwise attractive jobs.
column3: 对员工流动的研究发现，员工不满于反复搬家，使有些人辞去了原本有吸引力的工作。

column1: resolute^be resolute in 坚定地做……|resolve^resolve a dispute 解决争端|resource^natural resources 自然资源|respective^their respective 各自的……
column2: The two councils were resolute in seeking to resolve disputes over resources without allowing their respective political interests to block cooperation.
column3: 两个市政委员会坚定寻求解决资源争端，不让各自政治利益阻碍合作。

column1: respond^respond to 回应……|response^in response to 为回应……|rest^the rest of 其余……|restrain^restrain someone from 阻止某人……
column2: In response to complaints, managers responded by restraining noisy construction during rest periods rather than shifting the disturbance to the rest of the neighborhood.
column3: 为回应投诉，管理者限制了休息时段的嘈杂施工，而不是把干扰转移到社区其他地方。

column1: restraint^exercise restraint 保持克制|restrict^restrict access 限制进入|result^result in 导致……|resume^resume work 恢复工作
column2: Authorities exercised restraint in restricting access, allowing workers to resume repairs without the delays that a complete closure would have resulted in.
column3: 当局在限制进入方面保持克制，让工人恢复维修，避免了完全关闭本会造成的延误。

column1: retail^retail sales 零售额|retire^retire from 从……退休|retort^retort that 反驳说……|retreat^retreat from 放弃；从……撤退
column2: A retail worker about to retire retorted that online growth did not justify retreating from the obligation to train staff for new jobs.
column3: 一名临近退休的零售员工反驳说，线上业务增长，不能成为放弃培训员工适应新岗位这一责任的理由。

column1: retrieve^retrieve information 检索信息|retrospect^in retrospect 回顾起来|return^in return for 作为……的回报|revenge^take revenge on 报复……
column2: In retrospect, the employee regretted deleting files in revenge, since colleagues had to retrieve information in return for promises of overtime pay.
column3: 回顾起来，这名员工后悔报复性地删掉文件，因为同事不得不依靠承诺的加班费，额外工作来找回信息。

column1: revenue^tax revenue 税收收入|review^under review 审查中|revise^revise a plan 修改计划|revolve^revolve around 围绕……展开
column2: With tax revenue under review, the council revised plans that had revolved around optimistic assumptions about future tourism income.
column3: 税收收入受到审查后，市政委员会修改了那些建立在对未来旅游收入过度乐观假设上的计划。

column1: reward^reward someone for 因……奖励某人|rigorous^rigorous testing 严格测试|rival^a rival company 竞争公司|robust^a robust system 稳健系统
column2: Rewarding rapid releases may help a company overtake rivals, but rigorous testing is still needed to build robust systems.
column3: 奖励快速发布可能帮助公司超过对手，但要建立稳健系统，仍需要严格测试。

column1: romance^a sense of romance 浪漫感|romantic^a romantic ideal 浪漫理想|royal^the royal family 王室|rubbish^household rubbish 家庭垃圾
column2: The romantic image of royal gardens loses some of its charm when visitors see household rubbish where photographs had promised unspoilt romance.
column3: 游客在照片曾描绘纯粹浪漫的地方看到家庭垃圾时，皇家园林的浪漫形象就失去了一些魅力。

column1: rumor^spread a rumor 散布谣言|sacred^a sacred site 圣地|safeguard^safeguard the interests of 维护……的利益
column2: Rumors about development near a sacred site spread quickly, showing why officials must safeguard cultural interests through open discussion rather than private assurances.
column3: 有关圣地附近开发的谣言迅速传播，说明官员为何必须通过公开讨论，而非私下保证，维护文化利益。

column1: dust^household dust 家居灰尘|duty^a sense of duty 责任感|dwell^dwell on 反复思考；dwell in 居住于|dwelling^a private dwelling 私人住宅
column2: Inspectors have a duty to check dust levels in older dwellings rather than dwell only on their historic appearance.
column3: 检查员有责任检测老旧住宅的灰尘水平，而非只关注其历史外观。

column1: dynamic^a dynamic economy 充满活力的经济|dynasty^an ancient dynasty 古代王朝|echo^echo a view 呼应观点|eclipse^a solar eclipse 日食
column2: Ancient records of eclipses echo concerns about political stability, offering a dynamic picture of life under successive dynasties.
column3: 古代日食记录呼应了人们对政治稳定的关切，生动展现了历代王朝下的生活。

column1: ecology^urban ecology 城市生态学|economic^economic growth 经济增长|economics^behavioural economics 行为经济学|economy^the global economy 全球经济
column2: Urban ecology and economics increasingly overlap as cities ask whether economic growth can improve an economy without destroying the environment supporting it.
column3: 当城市探讨经济增长能否在不破坏其赖以存在的环境的前提下改善经济时，城市生态学与经济学日益交汇。

column1: edge^a competitive edge 竞争优势|edit^edit a manuscript 编辑稿件|edition^a revised edition 修订版|editor^a newspaper editor 报纸编辑
column2: Editors who carefully edit digital editions may give newspapers a competitive edge by offering reliable explanations rather than merely faster headlines.
column3: 认真编辑数字版本的编辑，或许能通过提供可靠解释而非仅仅抢发标题，为报纸带来竞争优势。

column1: educate^educate someone about 教导某人了解……|education^higher education 高等教育|effective^an effective way 有效方式|efficiency^energy efficiency 能源效率
column2: Education about energy efficiency is more effective when schools educate pupils through practical experiments rather than lists of technical facts.
column3: 如果学校通过实际实验而非罗列技术事实教学生了解能效，相关教育就会更有效。

column1: efficient^an efficient system 高效系统|effort^make an effort 努力|ego^a fragile ego 脆弱的自尊|electrical^electrical equipment 电气设备
column2: An efficient repair service requires the effort to admit mistakes, not the protection of a manager's ego when electrical equipment fails.
column3: 高效的维修服务需要努力承认错误，而非在电气设备出故障时维护经理的自尊。

column1: electricity^generate electricity 发电|elegant^an elegant solution 巧妙的解决方案|elevate^elevate the status 提升地位|elevator^take the elevator 乘电梯
column2: An elegant building design can reduce the electricity used by elevators while elevating the status of stairs as attractive public spaces.
column3: 巧妙的建筑设计可以减少电梯用电，同时让楼梯成为更受重视、更有吸引力的公共空间。

column1: eligible^be eligible for 有资格获得……|elite^the political elite 政治精英|embark^embark on 开始从事……|embarrass^be embarrassed by 因……尴尬
column2: The political elite were embarrassed when a scheme they had embarked on excluded many of the families supposedly eligible for support.
column3: 政治精英启动的一项计划，把许多本应有资格获得支持的家庭排除在外，这使他们感到尴尬。

column1: embody^embody a principle 体现原则|embrace^embrace change 接受变化|emerge^emerge from 从……出现|emergency^in an emergency 在紧急情况下
column2: New forms of cooperation emerged from the emergency, embodying a willingness to embrace changes that had previously seemed impossible.
column3: 紧急情况中出现了新的合作形式，体现出人们愿意接受那些先前看似不可能的变化。

column1: empathy^show empathy 表达同理心|emphasis^place emphasis on 强调……|employ^employ a method 采用方法|employee^employee satisfaction 员工满意度
column2: Managers employing regular interviews place greater emphasis on empathy when trying to understand employee dissatisfaction.
column3: 采用定期访谈的管理者，在试图理解员工不满时，会更加重视同理心。

column1: employer^a prospective employer 潜在雇主|employment^employment opportunities 就业机会|enclose^enclose a document 随附文件|encourage^encourage someone to do 鼓励某人做……
column2: To encourage fair employment, the agency asked employers to enclose clear information about pay and training with every job offer.
column3: 为促进公平就业，该机构要求雇主在每份录用通知中附上清晰的薪酬与培训信息。

column1: energetic^an energetic response 积极有力的回应|energy^renewable energy 可再生能源|enforce^enforce a rule 执行规则|engage^engage in 从事；参与
column2: Energetic volunteers engaged in saving energy urged the council to enforce existing rules before announcing more ambitious targets.
column3: 积极参与节能的志愿者敦促市政委员会，在宣布更宏大目标之前先执行现有规定。

column1: enhance^enhance understanding 增进理解|enlarge^enlarge the scope 扩大范围|enlighten^enlighten someone about 使某人了解……|enormous^an enormous amount of 大量……
column2: Enlarging the scope of a survey may produce enormous amounts of data without enlightening readers or enhancing their understanding of the original question.
column3: 扩大调查范围，可能产生海量数据，却没有启发读者，也没有增进他们对原始问题的理解。

column1: enquiry^make an enquiry 询问|enrich^enrich the experience 丰富体验|enterprise^a small enterprise 小企业|entire^the entire process 整个过程
column2: A small enterprise can enrich the customer experience by making the entire enquiry process simpler, rather than adding more automated replies.
column3: 小企业可以通过简化整个询问流程丰富顾客体验，而非增加更多自动回复。

column1: entitle^be entitled to 有权享有……|entrance^an entrance to ……的入口|entry^entry requirements 准入要求|environment^the built environment 建成环境
column2: Entry requirements should not prevent people entitled to public services from using an entrance designed for an accessible built environment.
column3: 准入要求不应阻止有权获得公共服务的人使用无障碍建筑环境中设计的入口。

column1: epidemic^an epidemic of ……的流行|equality^equality of opportunity 机会平等|equation^a mathematical equation 数学方程|erase^erase a record 删除记录
column2: No mathematical equation can erase the inequalities exposed by an epidemic, although better models may help governments pursue greater equality of opportunity.
column3: 任何数学方程都无法抹去流行病暴露的不平等，但更好的模型可能帮助政府争取更公平的机会。

column1: error^human error 人为错误|escape^escape from 逃离……|especially^especially when 尤其当……时|essence^in essence 本质上
column2: In essence, safety systems should prevent human errors from escalating, especially when workers cannot easily escape from a dangerous situation.
column3: 本质上，安全系统应防止人为错误升级，尤其是工人不容易逃离危险处境时。

column1: establish^establish a connection 建立联系|eternal^an eternal question 永恒问题|ethnic^an ethnic minority 少数族群|evacuate^evacuate residents 疏散居民
column2: After ethnic minority residents were evacuated, volunteers established support groups and revisited the eternal question of who counts as part of the community.
column3: 少数族群居民被疏散后，志愿者建立了支持小组，并重新探讨“谁属于社区成员”这个永恒问题。

column1: eve^on the eve of 在……前夕|eventually^eventually lead to 最终导致……|evident^be evident from 从……可明显看出|evoke^evoke memories 唤起回忆
column2: On the eve of the station's closure, old photographs evoked memories of journeys that had eventually changed residents' lives in evident ways.
column3: 车站关闭前夕，老照片唤起了人们对那些最终明显改变居民生活的旅程的回忆。

column1: evolution^the evolution of ……的演变|evolve^evolve into 演变成……|exaggerate^exaggerate the importance of 夸大……的重要性|exceed^exceed expectations 超出预期
column2: An account of the evolution of small businesses should not exaggerate how leaders help firms evolve when their ambitions exceed available resources.
column3: 解释小企业如何演变为大公司时，不应夸大领导者的作用，他们的雄心常常超出可用资源。

column1: excel^excel at 擅长……|excellent^an excellent example 很好的例子|excerpt^an excerpt from ……的节选|excess^in excess of 超过……
column2: An excerpt from the report provides an excellent example of how firms can excel at sales while producing waste far in excess of expectations.
column3: 报告的一段节选很好地说明了，企业如何在销售出色的同时产生远超预期的废物。

column1: exclaim^exclaim in surprise 惊呼|excessive^excessive use 过度使用|exclude^exclude A from B 把A排除在B之外|exempt^be exempt from 免于……
column2: Residents exclaimed in surprise when rules limiting excessive water use excluded the industrial users that officials had chosen to exempt.
column3: 限制过度用水的规定，把官员选择豁免的工业用水户排除在外，这使居民惊讶不已。

column1: exhibit^exhibit signs of 表现出……迹象|exhibition^an art exhibition 艺术展览|existence^come into existence 开始存在|expect^be expected to do 预计会做……
column2: An exhibition exploring the existence of urban wildlife showed that animals may exhibit unexpected adaptations to environments people expect to be hostile.
column3: 一场探讨城市野生动物生存的展览表明，在人们预期不利的环境中，动物可能表现出意想不到的适应能力。

column1: expend^expend effort on 在……上花费精力|expense^at the expense of 以牺牲……为代价|expensive^an expensive mistake 代价高昂的错误|experience^practical experience 实践经验
column2: Advisers argue that firms should expend more effort on practical experience instead of expensive publicity that raises prestige at the expense of learning.
column3: 顾问认为，企业应把更多精力花在实践经验上，而非花钱宣传、以牺牲学习为代价提高声望。

column1: experiment^conduct an experiment 做实验|expert^expert advice 专家建议|explain^explain why 解释为什么……|explode^explode a myth 破除迷思
column2: An expert explained why a simple experiment could explode the myth that people always make rational choices when presented with the same information.
column3: 一位专家解释了为什么一个简单实验能破除这样的迷思：得到相同信息时，人们总会理性选择。

column1: exploit^exploit an opportunity 利用机会|explore^explore the possibility 探讨可能性|export^export goods 出口商品|expose^expose someone to 使某人接触……
column2: Firms exploring export opportunities must avoid exploiting cheap labour in ways that expose workers to risks hidden from overseas consumers.
column3: 探寻出口机会的企业，必须避免以剥削廉价劳动力的方式，让工人承受海外消费者看不到的风险。

column1: exposure^exposure to 接触；暴露于|express^express concern 表达关切|extent^to some extent 在某种程度上|external^external factors 外部因素
column2: To some extent, concerns expressed about children's screen exposure reflect external pressures on families rather than evidence about any single device.
column3: 在某种程度上，人们对儿童屏幕接触的担忧，反映的是家庭外部压力，而非针对某一种设备的证据。

column1: extinct^become extinct 灭绝|extinguish^extinguish a fire 灭火|extra^at no extra cost 不额外收费|extract^extract A from B 从B中提取A
column2: Extracting minerals from a forest may bring extra income, but extinguishing frequent fires cannot bring back species that have already become extinct.
column3: 从森林中开采矿物可能增加收入，但扑灭频繁火灾也救不了那些已被逼近灭绝的物种。

column1: faculty^faculty members 教职员工|fade^fade away 逐渐消失|fairly^treat someone fairly 公平对待某人|faith^have faith in 信任……
column2: Students' faith in universities can fade when faculty members praise fairness in lectures but fail to treat junior colleagues fairly.
column3: 如果教师在讲课时赞美公平，却不能公平对待年轻同事，学生对大学的信任就会消退。

column1: fake^fake news 假新闻|false^a false impression 错误印象|familiar^be familiar with 熟悉……|famous^be famous for 因……闻名
column2: Familiar images of famous people can give fake news a false appearance of credibility, even when readers know little about the source.
column3: 熟悉的名人图像，可能让假新闻显得可信，即使读者对消息来源几乎一无所知。

column1: fan^a sports fan 体育迷|fantastic^a fantastic opportunity 极好的机会|fare^bus fares 公交车费|fascinate^be fascinated by 对……着迷
column2: Sports fans fascinated by distant tournaments may see cheap air fares as a fantastic opportunity, without considering the environmental cost of travel.
column3: 对远方赛事着迷的体育迷，可能把低价机票看成极好机会，而没有考虑旅行的环境成本。

column1: fashion^in fashion 流行的|fatigue^mental fatigue 心理疲劳|fault^find fault with 挑……的毛病|favor^in favor of 赞成……
column2: When constant criticism is in fashion, employees suffering from mental fatigue may favor familiar ideas simply to avoid having others find fault with them.
column3: 如果不断批评成为风气，心理疲劳的员工就可能偏向熟悉想法，只为避免被人挑错。

column1: favorite^a favorite choice 最喜欢的选择|feature^a key feature 关键特征|fee^tuition fees 学费|feedback^constructive feedback 建设性反馈
column2: Low fees make a course a favorite choice, but useful feedback and practical tasks should remain its key features.
column3: 低收费让一门课程受到喜爱，但有用的反馈与实践任务仍应是它的关键特色。

column1: female^female participation 女性参与|feminine^a feminine image 女性化形象|fence^a boundary fence 边界围栏|fertile^fertile ground for 滋生……的沃土
column2: Rigid ideas about feminine appearance can act like a fence around female participation, creating fertile ground for workplace inequality.
column3: 关于女性外表的僵化观念，可能像围栏一样限制女性参与，成为职场不平等滋生的沃土。

column1: festival^a cultural festival 文化节|fierce^fierce competition 激烈竞争|figure^a key figure 关键人物|final^the final stage 最后阶段
column2: Fierce competition between cities to host cultural festivals can leave local artists, supposedly the key figures, with little influence at the final planning stage.
column3: 城市之间争办文化节的激烈竞争，可能使本应是核心人物的本地艺术家，在规划最后阶段缺少影响力。

column1: finally^finally agree 最终同意|finance^public finance 公共财政|financial^financial support 经济支持|finite^finite resources 有限资源
column2: Officials finally agreed that financial support for the arts must be considered within public finance, where resources are finite and choices involve trade-offs.
column3: 官员最终同意，艺术资助必须纳入公共财政来考虑，因为资源有限，选择必然涉及取舍。

column1: flame^burst into flames 突然燃烧|flap^flap one's wings 拍翅|flash^in a flash 一瞬间|flee^flee from 逃离……
column2: Birds flapped their wings and fled as a field burst into flames, showing how a small spark can transform a habitat in a flash.
column3: 田地突然燃烧时，鸟儿拍翅逃离，显示出小小火星如何在瞬间改变栖息地。

column1: fleet^a fleet of 一队……|fling^fling away 扔掉|float^float on 漂浮在……上|fluent^be fluent in 流利使用……
column2: Volunteers fluent in several languages worked with a fishing fleet to collect plastic floating on the sea, much of it flung away far inland.
column3: 能流利使用多种语言的志愿者，与一支渔船队合作收集海上漂浮塑料，其中许多是从遥远内陆丢弃的。

column1: flush^flush out 冲出；排出|focus^focus on 关注……
column2: Campaigns focusing on river health explain why people should not flush medicines or household chemicals into systems designed to treat ordinary wastewater.
column3: 关注河流健康的活动解释了，为什么人们不应把药品或家用化学品冲入处理普通生活污水的系统。

column1: fold^fold up 折叠|forbid^forbid someone from doing 禁止某人做……
column2: The market forbids single-use bags, encouraging shoppers to carry reusable ones that can be folded into a pocket after use.
column3: 市场禁止一次性袋子，鼓励购物者携带用后可折进口袋的重复使用袋。

column1: force^a driving force 推动力|forecast^weather forecasts 天气预报|foreign^foreign investment 外商投资|foremost^first and foremost 首先；最重要的是
column2: First and foremost, foreign investment in farming should strengthen resilience to the forces of weather, rather than depend on perfect forecasts.
column3: 最重要的是，外商对农业的投资应增强应对天气影响的韧性，而非依赖完全准确的预报。

column1: foresee^foresee a problem 预见问题|forge^forge a partnership 建立伙伴关系|former^a former employee 前雇员|forthcoming^a forthcoming report 即将发布的报告
column2: A forthcoming report by former employees describes how a firm forged partnerships without foreseeing conflicts between its partners' commercial interests.
column3: 一份由前员工撰写、即将发布的报告描述了，一家公司建立伙伴关系时未能预见合作方商业利益之间的冲突。

column1: fortunate^be fortunate to do 有幸做……|fortune^make a fortune 发财|found^found a company 创办公司|foundation^lay the foundation for 为……奠定基础
column2: People fortunate enough to found successful companies often describe hard work as the foundation of their fortunes, giving less attention to timing and luck.
column3: 有幸创办成功公司的人，常把辛勤工作说成财富的基础，却较少关注时机与运气。

column1: fraud^financial fraud 金融诈骗|freeze^freeze an account 冻结账户|frequency^the frequency of ……的频率|frequent^frequent changes 频繁变化
column2: The increasing frequency of financial fraud has led banks to freeze more accounts, although frequent restrictions can also inconvenience honest customers.
column3: 金融诈骗发生频率上升，使银行冻结更多账户，尽管频繁限制也会给诚实客户带来不便。

column1: fright^give someone a fright 吓某人一跳|frighten^frighten someone into doing 吓得某人做……|fruitful^a fruitful discussion 富有成效的讨论|frustrate^frustrate an attempt 挫败尝试
column2: Frightening headlines can give readers a fright and frustrate attempts at fruitful discussion by making every disagreement seem like an immediate threat.
column3: 吓人的标题会让读者受惊，把每种分歧都说成眼前威胁，从而妨碍富有成效的讨论。

column1: fulfill^fulfill a promise 履行承诺|function^serve a function 发挥作用|fundamental^a fundamental change 根本变化|furious^be furious about 因……愤怒
column2: Residents furious about broken promises demanded fundamental changes to ensure that public consultation fulfilled its function rather than merely legitimised decisions.
column3: 居民因承诺落空而愤怒，要求作出根本改变，确保公众咨询发挥应有作用，而非只是让既定决定显得正当。

column1: furnish^furnish someone with 向某人提供……|furthermore^and furthermore 而且；此外|gain^gain access to 获得……的使用机会|gallery^an art gallery 美术馆
column2: The gallery furnished schools with free materials; furthermore, pupils gained access to artists who explained how their work developed.
column3: 美术馆为学校提供免费材料；此外，学生还获得了与艺术家接触的机会，听他们解释作品的形成过程。

column1: gather^gather evidence 收集证据|gaze^gaze at 凝视……|gear^be geared towards 以……为目标|gene^gene editing 基因编辑
column2: An exhibition geared towards children invited them to gaze at enlarged cells and gather evidence about how genes influence living things.
column3: 一场面向儿童的展览，邀请他们观察放大的细胞，并收集关于基因如何影响生物的证据。

column1: general^in general 总体而言|generate^generate income 创造收入|generation^the next generation 下一代|genius^a stroke of genius 天才之举
column2: In general, ideas praised as strokes of genius depend on knowledge generated by earlier generations rather than one person's isolated brilliance.
column3: 总体而言，被誉为天才之举的想法，依赖的是前几代人创造的知识，而非一个人孤立的才华。

column1: gentleman^a gentleman's agreement 君子协定|gently^gently remind 温和提醒|giant^a technology giant 科技巨头|glance^at a glance 一眼就……
column2: A gentleman's agreement with a technology giant may look reassuring at a glance, but advisers gently remind clients that enforceable terms matter more.
column3: 与科技巨头的君子协定，乍看或许令人安心，但顾问会温和提醒客户，可执行的条款更重要。

column1: glare^glare at 怒视……|global^global warming 全球变暖|gorgeous^gorgeous scenery 绚丽风景|govern^govern behaviour 约束行为
column2: Tourists enjoying gorgeous scenery may glare at signs announcing new restrictions, but rules governing visitor behaviour can protect landscapes threatened by global warming.
column3: 欣赏绚丽风景的游客，可能怒视宣布新限制的标识，但规范游客行为的规则能保护受全球变暖威胁的景观。

column1: government^central government 中央政府|gradual^a gradual decline 逐渐下降|graduate^graduate from 毕业于|graph^a line graph 折线图
column2: A government graph showed a gradual decline in secure employment among people who had recently graduated from university.
column3: 一张政府图表显示，最近大学毕业的人群中，稳定就业正在逐渐减少。

column1: graphic^graphic design 平面设计|grateful^be grateful for 感谢……|gratitude^express gratitude 表达感激|greenhouse^greenhouse gases 温室气体
column2: Campaigners expressed gratitude to graphic designers who helped explain greenhouse gas emissions in ways that grateful teachers could use in class.
column3: 活动组织者向平面设计师表达感激，他们帮助解释温室气体排放，让教师能够在课堂上使用相关材料。

column1: grown-up^a grown-up conversation 成熟的谈话|growth^economic growth 经济增长|guarantee^guarantee access 保证使用机会|guard^guard against 提防……
column2: A grown-up conversation about growth must guard against assuming that a larger economy automatically guarantees better lives for everyone.
column3: 成熟地讨论增长，必须警惕一种假设：经济规模变大，就会自动保证每个人生活更好。

column1: guidance^under the guidance of 在……指导下|guide^a practical guide 实用指南|habit^develop a habit 养成习惯|habitat^natural habitats 自然栖息地
column2: Under the guidance of local experts, children used a practical guide to develop habits that protect natural habitats near their school.
column3: 孩子们在当地专家指导下，借助实用指南养成保护学校附近自然栖息地的习惯。

column1: handful^a handful of 少数几个……|handicap^a serious handicap 严重障碍|harassment^workplace harassment 职场骚扰|hardship^financial hardship 经济困难
column2: Only a handful of workers reported harassment, since financial hardship and fear of losing work were serious handicaps to speaking openly.
column3: 只有少数工人举报了骚扰，因为经济困难与失业恐惧，严重阻碍了他们公开发声。

column1: hardware^computer hardware 计算机硬件|harmony^in harmony with 与……协调|harsh^harsh conditions 严酷条件|harvest^a good harvest 好收成
column2: Hardware designed for harsh conditions helps farmers predict harvests, but technology must work in harmony with local knowledge to be useful.
column3: 为严酷条件设计的硬件帮助农民预测收成，但技术必须与本地知识协调配合，才有实际用处。

column1: headmaster^a school headmaster 学校校长|headquarters^corporate headquarters 公司总部|height^at the height of 在……高峰期|heighten^heighten awareness 提高意识
column2: At the height of the debate, the headmaster visited corporate headquarters to heighten awareness of how unpaid internships excluded poorer students.
column3: 争论最激烈时，校长走访公司总部，希望让人们更清楚地认识到无薪实习如何排斥贫困学生。

column1: hence^and hence 因而|henceforth^henceforth be known as 此后被称为……|heritage^cultural heritage 文化遗产|hierarchy^a social hierarchy 社会等级体系
column2: The museum would henceforth explain social hierarchies alongside famous monuments, and hence present a broader account of the region's cultural heritage.
column3: 博物馆此后会在介绍著名遗迹的同时解释社会等级体系，从而更全面地呈现该地区的文化遗产。

column1: highlight^highlight a problem 突出问题|hinder^hinder progress 阻碍进步|historic^a historic decision 历史性决定|hitherto^hitherto unknown 迄今未知的
column2: The historic decision highlighted barriers that had hitherto hindered progress towards equal access to public information.
column3: 这一历史性决定，突出揭示了此前一直阻碍公众平等获取信息的障碍。

column1: hollow^a hollow promise 空洞承诺|honest^be honest about 坦诚面对……|honor^in honor of 为纪念……|honorable^an honorable intention 可敬的意图
column2: A monument built in honor of workers becomes a hollow gesture unless officials are honest about whether their honorable intentions improve present working conditions.
column3: 为纪念工人而建的纪念碑，如果官员不能坦诚说明善意是否改善了当下劳动条件，就会成为空洞姿态。

column1: horizon^broaden one's horizons 开阔眼界|hospital^a public hospital 公立医院|hospitality^the hospitality industry 酒店餐饮业|hover^hover around 在……附近徘徊
column2: Volunteering at a public hospital broadened the trainee's horizons beyond hospitality, even as wages in both sectors hovered around the local minimum.
column3: 在公立医院做志愿者，使这名实习生的眼界超出了酒店餐饮业，尽管两个行业的工资都徘徊在当地最低水平附近。

column1: human^human behaviour 人类行为|humanity^a sense of humanity 人道精神|humble^a humble beginning 卑微起点|humid^a humid climate 潮湿气候
column2: In humid shelters, the simple act of providing dry bedding shows how human dignity and a sense of humanity can have humble beginnings.
column3: 在潮湿的避难所，提供干燥被褥这一简单举动，说明人的尊严与人道精神可以从微小之处开始。

column1: humidity^high humidity 高湿度|hypocrisy^political hypocrisy 政治虚伪|hypothesis^test a hypothesis 检验假设|identify^identify a cause 确定原因
column2: Researchers testing a hypothesis about humidity identified poor ventilation as a cause of mould, exposing the hypocrisy of officials who blamed residents alone.
column3: 研究者检验有关湿度的假设时，发现通风不良是霉菌产生的原因之一，揭露了那些只责怪居民的官员的虚伪。

column1: identity^a sense of identity 身份认同|ignite^ignite a debate 引发辩论|ignorance^ignorance of 对……的无知|ignorant^be ignorant of 不了解……
column2: A debate about local identity was ignited by a proposal whose authors seemed ignorant of history, reminding residents of the cost of official ignorance.
column3: 一份作者似乎不了解历史的提案，引发了地方认同之争，提醒居民官方无知会造成什么代价。

column1: ignore^ignore a warning 无视警告|illegal^illegal activities 非法活动|illuminate^illuminate a problem 阐明问题|illustrate^illustrate a point 说明一个观点
column2: Examples of illegal dumping illustrate how ignored warnings can grow into major problems, illuminating the gap between formal rules and actual enforcement.
column3: 非法倾倒垃圾的例子说明，被忽视的警告如何演变为大问题，并揭示正式规则与实际执行之间的差距。

column1: image^a public image 公众形象|imagine^imagine doing 想象做……|imitate^imitate others 模仿他人|immediate^an immediate response 立即回应
column2: Brands imagine that imitating a rival's public image will bring immediate success, overlooking the trust built through years of consistent service.
column3: 品牌以为模仿对手的公众形象就能立刻成功，却忽视了多年稳定服务所建立的信任。

column1: immense^immense pressure 巨大压力|immigrant^immigrant communities 移民社区|imminent^an imminent threat 迫在眉睫的威胁|impact^have an impact on 对……有影响
column2: Immigrant communities facing immense housing pressure described the imminent closure of local services as a threat with a lasting impact.
column3: 承受巨大住房压力的移民社区，把当地服务即将关闭描述为一种会产生持久影响的威胁。

column1: impatient^be impatient with 对……不耐烦|imperative^it is imperative that ……至关重要|impetus^give impetus to 推动……|import^import goods 进口商品
column2: Impatient consumers may demand cheaper imports, yet it is imperative that competition give impetus to better production rather than lower safety standards.
column3: 不耐烦的消费者可能要求更便宜的进口商品，但竞争必须推动更好的生产，而非降低安全标准。

column1: importance^attach importance to 重视……|important^be important for 对……重要|impossible^find it impossible to do 发现不可能做……|impress^impress someone with 用……给某人留下印象
column2: Trust becomes important when firms find it impossible to impress customers after service failures, revealing the importance of reliability over novelty.
column3: 企业反复服务失败后，发现新功能已无法打动顾客，此时信任的重要性就显现出来。

column1: impressive^an impressive achievement 出色成就|improve^improve access 改善使用机会|incidence^the incidence of ……的发生率|incident^a serious incident 严重事件
column2: An impressive fall in recorded injury incidence does not prove safety has improved if serious incidents are being reported less often.
column3: 记录的工伤发生率显著下降，如果严重事件上报得更少，就不能证明安全改善。

column1: inclusive^inclusive growth 包容性增长|income^household income 家庭收入|incorporate^incorporate A into B 把A纳入B|increase^an increase in ……的增加
column2: Inclusive growth requires incorporating low-income households into decisions about services, not merely increasing the total income recorded in national accounts.
column3: 包容性增长要求低收入家庭参与服务决策，而不只是增加国民账户记录的总收入。

column1: increasingly^increasingly important 越来越重要|incredible^an incredible amount of 极多的……|indeed^indeed it is 的确如此|independent^be independent of 独立于……
column2: Independent local reporting is increasingly important; indeed, an incredible amount of online information still depends on a few original investigations.
column3: 独立地方报道日益重要；事实上，数量庞大的网络信息仍依赖少数原创调查。

column1: indifferent^be indifferent to 对……漠不关心|indignant^be indignant at 对……愤慨|indispensable^be indispensable to 对……不可或缺|indoor^indoor air quality 室内空气质量
column2: Residents indignant at poor indoor air quality asked why officials were indifferent to inspections supposedly indispensable to public health.
column3: 居民对糟糕的室内空气质量感到愤慨，质问为何被视为公共健康不可或缺的检查，却受到冷漠对待。

column1: induce^induce someone to do 诱使某人做……|industrial^industrial production 工业生产|industry^the manufacturing industry 制造业|inevitable^an inevitable consequence 不可避免的后果
column2: Industrial policy should induce manufacturers to reduce waste rather than treat pollution as an inevitable consequence of a growing industry.
column3: 产业政策应促使制造商减少浪费，而非把污染视为行业发展的必然后果。

column1: infant^infant care 婴儿照护|infectious^infectious diseases 传染病|infer^infer A from B 从B推断A|infinite^an infinite number of 无数的……
column2: Researchers cannot infer an infant's risk of infectious disease from one factor, even though the possible combinations of circumstances may seem almost infinite.
column3: 研究者不能仅凭一个因素推断婴儿感染传染病的风险，尽管各种情况的可能组合看似近乎无限。

column1: influence^have an influence on 对……有影响|inform^inform someone of 告知某人……|information^access to information 获取信息|ingredient^a key ingredient 关键要素
column2: Access to reliable information is a key ingredient of public trust, but informing people does not guarantee that evidence will influence their decisions.
column3: 获得可靠信息是公众信任的关键要素，但告知人们信息，并不保证证据会影响他们的决定。

column1: inhabit^inhabit an area 栖息于某地|inhabitant^local inhabitants 当地居民|inherent^be inherent in 是……固有的|inhibit^inhibit growth 抑制增长
column2: Local inhabitants argued that protecting the species inhabiting nearby wetlands was an inherent public duty, not a measure designed to inhibit growth.
column3: 当地居民认为，保护附近湿地栖息的物种是本应承担的公共责任，而非刻意抑制增长的措施。

column1: initial^an initial response 最初反应|initiate^initiate a project 启动项目|injure^be injured in 在……中受伤|injury^a serious injury 严重伤害
column2: The initial response to serious injuries was to blame injured workers, but the union initiated a project examining the organisation of shifts.
column3: 严重伤害发生后的最初反应，是责怪受伤工人，但工会启动了一个考察轮班安排的项目。

column1: inner^inner-city areas 内城区|innocent^innocent of 无……罪的|input^public input 公众意见|insert^insert A into B 把A插入B
column2: Officials inserted local input into the inner-city safety plan after residents objected that innocent young people were being treated as potential criminals.
column3: 居民抗议无辜年轻人被当作潜在罪犯后，官员把当地意见纳入了内城区安全计划。

column1: insight^an insight into 对……的深入了解|inspect^inspect a building 检查建筑|inspire^inspire confidence 激发信心|install^install equipment 安装设备
column2: Inspecting old buildings before installing new equipment can provide insights into hidden risks and inspire confidence among residents.
column3: 安装新设备前检查老旧建筑，有助于深入了解隐藏风险，并增强居民的信心。

column1: instant^in an instant 立即|institute^a research institute 研究机构|institution^a financial institution 金融机构|instruct^instruct someone to do 指示某人做……
column2: A research institute warned financial institutions against instructing customers to make decisions in an instant when complex risks were involved.
column3: 一家研究机构警告金融机构，不要在涉及复杂风险时，指示客户立即作决定。

column1: instruction^follow instructions 按指示行事|instrument^a measuring instrument 测量仪器|insulate^insulate A from B 使A免受B影响|insult^an insult to 对……的侮辱
column2: Clear instructions for using measuring instruments can insulate trainees from avoidable mistakes without insulting their intelligence.
column3: 清晰的测量仪器使用说明，能够帮助受训者避免本可避免的错误，而不会侮辱他们的智力。

column1: insurance^health insurance 医疗保险|integrate^integrate A into B 把A融入B|intellectual^intellectual property 知识产权|intelligent^an intelligent system 智能系统
column2: Integrating intelligent systems into health insurance raises questions about intellectual property and who can challenge an automated decision.
column3: 把智能系统整合到医疗保险中，会引出知识产权以及谁能质疑自动化决定等问题。

column1: interact^interact with 与……互动|intense^intense pressure 强大压力|intensity^the intensity of ……的强度|intensive^intensive training 高强度训练
column2: Intensive training can help staff interact with difficult clients, but increasing its intensity does not remove the intense pressure caused by understaffing.
column3: 密集培训能帮助员工与难应对的客户沟通，但提高培训强度，并不能消除人手不足造成的巨大压力。

column1: intention^with the intention of 以……为目的|interest^in the interests of 为了……的利益|interesting^an interesting question 有趣问题|interface^a user interface 用户界面
column2: An interesting question is whether an interface designed with good intentions actually serves users' interests or merely keeps them online longer.
column3: 一个有趣的问题是，出于好意设计的界面，究竟服务于用户利益，还是只让用户在线更久。

column1: intermediate^an intermediate stage 中间阶段|intermittent^intermittent access 时断时续的使用机会|internal^internal communication 内部沟通|internet^internet access 网络接入
column2: At an intermediate stage of expansion, the firm relied on intermittent internet access, making even simple internal communication surprisingly difficult.
column3: 扩张到中间阶段时，公司依赖时断时续的网络接入，就连简单的内部沟通也变得出奇困难。

column1: interpret^interpret A as B 将A理解为B|interval^at regular intervals 定期|interview^a job interview 求职面试|intimate^intimate knowledge 深入了解
column2: Interviews at regular intervals can give researchers intimate knowledge of working lives, but silence should not automatically be interpreted as satisfaction.
column3: 定期访谈能让研究者深入了解工作生活，但沉默不应自动被理解为满意。

column1: invent^invent a method 发明方法|introduce^introduce A to B 向B引入A|introduction^the introduction of ……的引入|invaluable^invaluable experience 极宝贵的经验
column2: Introducing staff to experienced colleagues offers invaluable experience; even the introduction of newly invented training software cannot replace that contact.
column3: 让员工接触有经验的同事，能带来极宝贵的经验；即便引入新发明的培训软件，也无法取代这种接触。

column1: invention^a new invention 新发明|inverse^an inverse relationship 反比关系|invert^invert the order 颠倒顺序|investment^return on investment 投资回报
column2: An invention that inverts the usual production order may reveal an inverse relationship between initial investment and later operating costs.
column3: 一种颠倒常规生产顺序的发明，可能揭示初始投资与后期运营成本之间的反向关系。

column1: invisible^invisible barriers 无形障碍|invite^invite someone to do 邀请某人做……|inward^look inward 反省自身|irritate^be irritated by 因……恼怒
column2: Inviting employees to discuss invisible barriers requires leaders to look inward rather than become irritated by criticism of established routines.
column3: 邀请员工讨论无形障碍，需要领导者反省自身，而非因既定流程受到批评就恼怒。

column1: jealous^be jealous of 嫉妒……|journal^an academic journal 学术期刊|journalist^an investigative journalist 调查记者|journey^a journey towards 迈向……的历程
column2: A journalist tracing a scientist's journey through academic journals found that jealous competition could coexist with generous cooperation.
column3: 一名记者通过学术期刊追溯科学家的历程时发现，嫉妒性的竞争可以与慷慨的合作并存。

column1: judge^judge A by B 根据B判断A|judgment^make a judgment 作判断|junior^junior staff 初级员工|juvenile^juvenile crime 青少年犯罪
column2: Judging junior staff by stereotypes about juvenile behaviour can produce unfair judgments about people who are still learning professional expectations.
column3: 依据青少年行为的刻板印象判断初级员工，可能对尚在学习职业要求的人造成不公正评价。

column1: laboratory^a laboratory experiment 实验室实验|labor^manual labor 体力劳动|lag^lag behind 落后于……|landscape^the economic landscape 经济格局
column2: Laboratory advances can reshape the economic landscape, but wages for manual labor may lag behind the productivity gains they help create.
column3: 实验室的进步可以重塑经济格局，但体力劳动者的工资，可能落后于他们帮助创造的生产率增长。

column1: language^a common language 共同语言|latent^latent demand 潜在需求|lateral^lateral thinking 横向思维|latitude^give someone latitude 给某人自由空间
column2: Giving teams latitude to use lateral thinking can reveal latent demand, provided that specialists develop a common language for discussing customers' needs.
column3: 给予团队运用横向思维的空间，可能揭示潜在需求，前提是专家发展出讨论顾客需求的共同语言。

column1: launch^launch a campaign 发起活动|laundry^do the laundry 洗衣服|lawsuit^file a lawsuit 提起诉讼|lawyer^consult a lawyer 咨询律师
column2: Lawyers launched a campaign after tenants filed a lawsuit over shared laundry facilities that landlords had promised but never provided.
column3: 租户就房东承诺却未提供的共用洗衣设施提起诉讼后，律师发起了一场活动。

column1: layout^an office layout 办公室布局|leadership^leadership skills 领导能力|league^a sports league 体育联盟|lease^a long-term lease 长期租约
column2: The sports league's leadership reconsidered its long-term lease after discovering that the office layout prevented staff from working together effectively.
column3: 体育联盟的领导层发现办公室布局妨碍员工高效合作后，重新考虑了长期租约。

column1: legal^legal advice 法律建议|legend^an urban legend 都市传说|legislation^pass legislation 通过立法|legitimate^a legitimate concern 合理担忧
column2: Legal advice helped distinguish urban legends from legitimate concerns before lawmakers passed legislation governing the use of personal data.
column3: 立法者通过个人数据使用方面的法律前，法律建议帮助他们区分了都市传说与合理担忧。

column1: leisure^leisure time 闲暇时间|lesson^learn a lesson 吸取教训|liable^be liable for 对……负法律责任|liberal^a liberal education 通识教育
column2: A liberal education should teach the lesson that people enjoying leisure activities may still be liable for damage caused to others.
column3: 通识教育应让人明白，休闲活动也伴随责任，包括对给他人造成的损害承担法律责任。

column1: liberty^civil liberties 公民自由|library^a public library 公共图书馆|license^a license to do 做……的许可|likelihood^the likelihood of ……的可能性
column2: Requiring a license to use public libraries could reduce the likelihood of participation and raise concerns about civil liberties.
column3: 要求获得许可才能使用公共图书馆，可能降低公众参与的可能性，并引发对公民自由的担忧。

column1: likewise^and likewise 同样地|limit^set a limit on 对……设限|limitation^a limitation of ……的局限|linguistic^linguistic diversity 语言多样性
column2: Standardised tests have linguistic limitations; likewise, setting strict limits on acceptable answers can overlook valuable forms of understanding.
column3: 标准化测试存在语言方面的局限；同样，严格限制可接受的答案，可能忽略有价值的理解方式。

column1: liquid^liquid assets 流动资产|literally^take something literally 按字面理解某事|literary^literary criticism 文学批评|literature^scientific literature 科学文献
column2: Readers of financial literature should not take the term liquid assets literally, just as literary critics distinguish metaphor from physical description.
column3: 阅读金融文献的人，不应按字面理解“流动资产”，就像文学评论家会区分比喻与实物描述一样。

column1: loan^take out a loan 贷款|lobby^lobby for 游说争取；a hotel lobby 酒店大堂|local^local knowledge 本地知识|locality^in the locality 在当地
column2: Local businesses lobbied for affordable loans, arguing that knowledge of the locality made them better placed than distant investors to restore empty shops.
column3: 本地企业游说争取低息贷款，认为熟悉当地使它们比远方投资者更适合恢复空置商铺。

column1: locate^be located in 位于……|location^a convenient location 便利位置|lock^lock someone into 使某人陷入……|logic^the logic of ……的逻辑
column2: The logic of choosing a convenient location can lock firms into expensive leases, even when their customers are located elsewhere.
column3: 选择便利位置的逻辑，可能使企业受困于昂贵租约，即使其顾客实际位于别处。

column1: logical^a logical conclusion 合理结论|loom^loom large 显得重要；令人担忧|loop^a feedback loop 反馈回路|loose^a loose connection 松散联系
column2: When costs loom large, a loose connection between spending and results can create a feedback loop that makes cuts seem like the only logical conclusion.
column3: 成本压力显著时，支出与成果之间松散的联系，可能形成反馈回路，使削减开支看似唯一合理结论。

column1: loosen^loosen restrictions 放宽限制|loyal^be loyal to 忠于……|loyalty^customer loyalty 顾客忠诚度|luxury^a luxury item 奢侈品
column2: Luxury brands loosening restrictions on repairs may gain customer loyalty by showing that being loyal to a product need not mean buying a replacement.
column3: 奢侈品牌放宽维修限制，可能赢得顾客忠诚，表明忠于产品并不一定意味着再买一件。

column1: machine^machine learning 机器学习|mad^be mad at 生……的气|magazine^a weekly magazine 周刊|magnificent^a magnificent building 宏伟建筑
column2: A magazine praising machine learning used a magnificent building as an example, but residents were mad that its automated systems repeatedly failed.
column3: 一本赞扬机器学习的杂志以一座宏伟建筑为例，居民却因其自动化系统屡次失灵而愤怒。

column1: magnitude^the magnitude of ……的程度|maintenance^routine maintenance 日常维护|major^a major concern 主要关切|majority^the vast majority of ……的绝大多数
column2: The vast majority of complaints concerned maintenance, revealing the magnitude of a problem that had not appeared in the project's major performance measures.
column3: 绝大多数投诉与维护有关，揭示出一个未被项目主要绩效指标反映的问题有多严重。

column1: manage^manage to do 设法做到……|management^time management 时间管理|manager^a project manager 项目经理|manifest^manifest itself in 表现为……
column2: Poor time management manifests itself in repeated delays, yet project managers sometimes manage to hide these failures behind favourable summaries.
column3: 糟糕的时间管理表现为反复延期，但项目经理有时能用好看的摘要掩盖这些失败。

column1: mankind^the future of mankind 人类未来|manner^in a manner 以……方式|manual^an instruction manual 使用说明书|manufacture^manufacture goods 制造商品
column2: Manufacturing technology may shape mankind's future, but clear manuals still matter if workers are to use equipment in a safe and reliable manner.
column3: 制造技术可能塑造人类未来，但要让工人安全可靠地使用设备，清晰说明书依然重要。

column1: margin^a profit margin 利润率|marine^marine life 海洋生物|market^market demand 市场需求|massive^a massive increase 大幅增加
column2: Massive demand in the seafood market can narrow profit margins and encourage fishing methods that damage marine life beyond the species being sold.
column3: 对廉价海产品的巨大需求，可能压缩利润空间，并鼓励那些不仅伤害销售物种、也破坏其他海洋生物的捕捞方式。

column1: master^master a skill 掌握技能|masterpiece^a literary masterpiece 文学杰作|material^raw materials 原材料|mathematical^a mathematical model 数学模型
column2: A mathematical model can describe the materials used in a masterpiece, but mastering its technique requires more than measuring physical ingredients.
column3: 数学模型可以描述杰作所用材料，但掌握其技法，远不止测量物质成分。

column1: mathematics^applied mathematics 应用数学|matter^a matter of ……的问题|mature^a mature market 成熟市场|maximum^the maximum amount 最大数量
column2: In a mature market, pricing is not simply a matter of mathematics designed to extract the maximum amount from each customer.
column3: 成熟市场中的定价，不只是一个用数学从每位顾客那里获取最高金额的问题。

column1: meantime^in the meantime 在此期间|meadow^a wildflower meadow 野花草地
column2: Restoring the meadow will take years; in the meantime, temporary paths can let residents enjoy the area without damaging new growth.
column3: 恢复草地需要多年；在此期间，临时小路可以让居民欣赏这片区域，而不损坏新生植被。

column1: meanwhile^meanwhile however 与此同时却|measure^take measures 采取措施
column2: Officials took measures to reduce traffic near schools; meanwhile, residents asked whether safer routes would also be provided for older pedestrians.
column3: 官员采取措施减少学校附近交通；与此同时，居民询问是否也会为老年行人提供更安全的路线。

column1: mechanism^a feedback mechanism 反馈机制|media^social media 社交媒体|mediate^mediate between 在……之间调解|medical^medical care 医疗服务
column2: A complaint mechanism can mediate between patients and medical providers before disputes spread through social media.
column3: 投诉机制可以在纠纷通过社交媒体扩散之前，调解患者与医疗服务提供者之间的分歧。

column1: medicine^preventive medicine 预防医学|medium^a medium of communication 交流媒介|melody^a familiar melody 熟悉旋律|member^a community member 社区成员
column2: A familiar melody can serve as a medium for sharing information about preventive medicine among community members who find written leaflets difficult.
column3: 对难以阅读宣传单的社区成员而言，熟悉的旋律可以成为传播预防医学信息的媒介。

column1: membership^membership fees 会费|memorandum^a memorandum of understanding 谅解备忘录|memorial^a war memorial 战争纪念碑|memory^in memory of 为纪念……
column2: A memorandum allowed membership fees to support the memorial, preserving the memory of local people whose stories were absent from official histories.
column3: 一份备忘录允许用会费支持纪念设施，保存那些未被官方历史记录的本地人的记忆。

column1: menace^a menace to 对……的威胁|mention^not to mention 更不用说|merchant^a local merchant 本地商人|mercury^mercury pollution 汞污染
column2: Merchants warned that mercury pollution was a menace to fishing, not to mention the wider costs to tourism and public health.
column3: 商人警告说，汞污染威胁渔业，更不用说它给旅游与公共健康造成的更广泛代价。

column1: mercy^at the mercy of 任由……摆布|mere^a mere fraction of ……的一小部分|merely^not merely 不仅仅|merge^merge with 与……合并
column2: Small firms at the mercy of larger suppliers may merge merely to survive, even if the resulting business controls only a mere fraction of the market.
column3: 任由大供应商摆布的小企业，可能只是为了生存而合并，即使合并后的企业也只控制市场的一小部分。

column1: mess^a financial mess 财务混乱|message^convey a message 传达信息|method^a research method 研究方法|metropolitan^a metropolitan area 大都市地区
column2: The survey method conveyed a clear message: transport planning across the metropolitan area remained a mess despite separate districts reporting progress.
column3: 这项调查方法传达出明确信息：尽管各区分别报告进展，大都市地区的整体交通规划仍然混乱。

column1: mill^a steel mill 钢厂|mild^a mild climate 温和气候
column2: Even a mild slowdown can threaten an old mill, so training workers for other industries should begin before the business faces closure.
column3: 即使温和放缓也可能威胁老工厂，因此在企业面临关闭前，就应开始培训员工转向其他行业。

column1: militant^a militant group 激进团体|military^military spending 军费开支
column2: A militant group demanded cuts in military spending, arguing that public funds should support housing and education rather than more weapons.
column3: 一个激进团体要求削减军费，认为公共资金应支持住房与教育，而非更多武器。

column1: minister^a government minister 政府部长|million^millions of 数百万……|mineral^mineral resources 矿产资源
column2: A minister promised that millions earned from mineral resources would help fund schools and clinics in communities near the mines.
column3: 一位部长承诺，矿产资源赚取的数百万收入，将帮助资助矿区附近社区的学校与诊所。

column1: minimum^a minimum wage 最低工资
column2: A minimum wage can raise earnings, but its effect on living standards also depends on housing costs and the hours of work available.
column3: 最低工资可以提高收入，但它对生活水平的影响，也取决于住房成本和能够获得的工作时数。

column1: ministry^the ministry of education 教育部|minor^a minor change 小变化|minority^a minority of 少数……|minus^minus the cost 扣除成本
column2: The ministry described the reform as a minor change, but a minority of schools found that their budgets, minus new costs, had fallen sharply.
column3: 主管部门把改革说成小调整，但少数学校发现，扣除新增成本后，预算已大幅缩水。

column1: minute^minute details 极细微的细节|miracle^an economic miracle 经济奇迹|mirror^mirror a trend 反映趋势|miserable^miserable conditions 悲惨处境
column2: An economic miracle may mirror rising national income while minute details of surveys reveal that many workers still live in miserable conditions.
column3: 经济奇迹可能反映国民收入上升，而调查中的细微细节却表明，许多工人仍生活在悲惨处境中。

column1: misery^human misery 人间苦难|misfortune^suffer a misfortune 遭遇不幸|mislead^mislead someone into doing 误导某人做……|mission^a mission to do 做……的使命
column2: A mission to reduce human misery can fail if misleading statistics encourage officials to treat persistent disadvantage as a series of individual misfortunes.
column3: 如果误导性统计使官员把持续的不利处境当成一连串个人不幸，减轻人类苦难的使命就可能失败。

column1: mistake^mistake A for B 把A误认为B|misunderstand^misunderstand the meaning 误解含义|mix^mix A with B 把A与B混合|mixture^a mixture of ……的混合
column2: Readers may misunderstand an argument when writers mix facts with opinions, creating a mixture that makes readers mistake preference for scientific conclusion.
column3: 事实与观点混在一起，使人把个人偏好误认为科学结论时，读者就可能误解论证。

column1: academy^a national academy 国家级研究院|accelerate^accelerate growth 加快增长|ability^the ability to do 做……的能力|abide^abide by 遵守
column2: The academy aims to accelerate research while strengthening scientists' ability to abide by rules protecting personal data.
column3: 研究院希望加快研究，同时增强科学家遵守个人数据保护规定的能力。

column1: accept^accept responsibility 承担责任|abnormal^abnormal behaviour 反常行为|accident^a road accident 道路事故|accessory^an essential accessory 必备配件
column2: Drivers must accept responsibility for accidents rather than blame an electronic accessory whenever a vehicle shows abnormal behaviour.
column3: 车辆出现异常表现时，驾驶者必须为事故承担责任，而非总把问题归咎于某个电子配件。

column1: acclaim^win critical acclaim 赢得评论界赞誉|absent^be absent from 缺席；不存在于|accord^in accord with 与……一致|absolute^absolute certainty 绝对确定性
column2: The book won critical acclaim for admitting that absolute certainty is absent from science, in accord with the author's cautious approach.
column3: 这本书承认科学不存在绝对确定性，这与作者谨慎的方法一致，也使其赢得了评论界赞誉。

column1: accumulate^accumulate wealth 积累财富|accuracy^the accuracy of ……的准确性|accuse^accuse someone of 指控某人……|addition^in addition to 除……之外
column2: In addition to questioning the accuracy of company accounts, critics accused executives of accumulating wealth at the expense of ordinary workers.
column3: 除了质疑公司账目的准确性，批评者还指责高管以普通员工的利益为代价积累财富。

column1: achieve^achieve a goal 实现目标|adequate^adequate support 充分支持|acknowledge^acknowledge the importance of 承认……的重要性|acquaint^acquaint oneself with 熟悉……
column2: New employees can achieve more when managers acknowledge their need for adequate support and time to acquaint themselves with unfamiliar procedures.
column3: 如果管理者承认新员工需要充分支持、需要时间熟悉陌生流程，新员工就能取得更多成就。

column1: adjacent^be adjacent to 紧邻……|acquire^acquire knowledge 获得知识|administer^administer a fund 管理基金|admit^admit to 承认……
column2: The council admitted that acquiring land adjacent to the station would require better administration of the housing fund it administered.
column3: 市政委员会承认，购买车站旁的土地，需要更好地管理其负责的住房基金。

column1: action^take action 采取行动|activate^activate a system 启动系统|active^take an active part in 积极参与|activity^physical activity 身体活动
column2: An active neighborhood group took action to activate unused public space, creating areas for children's physical activity.
column3: 一个活跃的社区团体采取行动启用闲置公共空间，为儿童创造了身体活动场所。

column1: adolescent^adolescent development 青少年发展|adult^adult education 成人教育|actual^actual experience 实际经历|advance^advances in ……的进展
column2: Advances in research on adolescent development suggest that adult expectations should reflect teenagers' actual experience rather than idealised models of maturity.
column3: 青少年发展研究的进展表明，成年人的期望应符合青少年的实际经历，而非理想化的成熟模式。

column1: acute^an acute shortage 严重短缺|advantage^take advantage of 利用|aftermath^in the aftermath of 在……之后|advent^the advent of ……的出现
column2: In the aftermath of the recession, an acute skills shortage prevented small firms from taking advantage of the advent of new manufacturing tools.
column3: 经济衰退之后，严重的技能短缺使小企业无法利用新制造工具出现带来的机会。

column1: adventure^a sense of adventure 冒险精神|afterward^shortly afterward 不久以后|advertise^advertise for 招聘；登广告寻找|advice^seek advice 寻求建议
column2: A sense of adventure may draw graduates to jobs advertised abroad, but seeking advice beforehand can prevent difficulties shortly afterward.
column3: 冒险精神可能吸引毕业生申请海外招聘的职位，但事先寻求建议可以避免随后出现困难。

column1: agency^a government agency 政府机构|advise^advise someone to do 建议某人做……|advocate^advocate for 倡导；支持|aggravate^aggravate a problem 加剧问题
column2: The agency advised employers to avoid practices that aggravate stress, while advocates for workers called for clearer legal limits on overtime.
column3: 该机构建议雇主避免加剧压力的做法，而劳动者权益倡导者呼吁对加班作出更明确的法律限制。

column1: aggressive^aggressive marketing 强势营销|agitate^agitate for 鼓动争取……|agony^in agony 极其痛苦|affection^show affection 表达喜爱
column2: Parents agitated for limits on aggressive marketing after seeing children in agony over products that advertisements linked to parental affection.
column3: 看到孩子因广告把商品与父母的爱联系起来而痛苦不堪，家长纷纷争取限制强势营销。

column1: affiliate^be affiliated with 附属于……|agriculture^sustainable agriculture 可持续农业|afford^can afford to do 有能力做……|aid^financial aid 经济援助
column2: A college affiliated with the farming institute offers financial aid so that more young people can afford to study sustainable agriculture.
column3: 一所隶属农业研究机构的学院提供经济援助，让更多年轻人负担得起可持续农业方面的学习。

column1: air conditioning^energy-efficient air conditioning 节能空调|allow^allow for 考虑到；留出余地|alongside^work alongside 与……共事
column2: Working alongside residents, designers allowed for hotter summers and proposed shading that would reduce dependence on air conditioning.
column3: 设计师与居民合作，把夏季更加炎热的情况考虑在内，提出用遮阴减少对空调的依赖。

column1: alcohol^alcohol consumption 饮酒量
column2: Higher alcohol prices may reduce consumption, but effective health policy should also consider why some people depend on drinking to cope with stress.
column3: 更高的酒价可能减少饮酒，但有效健康政策还应考虑，有些人为什么依靠饮酒应对压力。

column1: alien^be alien to 对……陌生；与……格格不入|alter^alter the balance 改变平衡|alternate^alternate between 在……之间交替|alive^keep something alive 使……延续
column2: Schools can keep local traditions alive by alternating between familiar activities and ideas that initially seem alien, gradually altering the balance between them.
column3: 学校可以在熟悉的活动与起初显得陌生的想法之间交替，逐渐调整二者的平衡，使地方传统延续。

column1: altitude^at high altitude 在高海拔地区|amaze^be amazed at 对……感到惊奇|ambiguous^an ambiguous statement 含糊的说法|ambition^achieve an ambition 实现抱负
column2: Researchers amazed at crops growing at high altitude warned that ambiguous statements about yield could encourage unrealistic commercial ambitions.
column3: 研究者对高海拔地区生长的作物感到惊奇，但警告说，含糊的产量表述可能助长不切实际的商业抱负。

column1: anger^public anger 公众愤怒|angle^from a different angle 从不同角度|ambitious^an ambitious plan 雄心勃勃的计划|amend^amend a law 修订法律
column2: Public anger forced ministers to examine the ambitious plan from a different angle and amend the law before expanding the scheme.
column3: 公众的愤怒迫使部长们从不同角度审视这项雄心勃勃的计划，并在扩大计划前修订法律。

column1: amount^amount to 总计；相当于|announce^announce a decision 宣布决定|ample^ample opportunity 充分机会|annoy^be annoyed by 被……惹恼
column2: The amount spent on consultation annoyed residents, who said they had not been given ample opportunity to respond before the decision was announced.
column3: 咨询所花的金额让居民恼火，他们说决定宣布之前，自己并未获得充分表达意见的机会。

column1: amplify^amplify a signal 放大信号|annual^an annual report 年度报告|anonymous^remain anonymous 保持匿名|amuse^amuse oneself 自娱
column2: Anonymous online comments can amplify criticism of an annual report, even when some contributors are merely amusing themselves rather than analysing its findings.
column3: 匿名网络评论会放大对年度报告的批评，即使一些发言者只是在自娱，而非分析报告结果。

column1: analysis^an analysis of 对……的分析|anticipate^anticipate demand 预测需求|ancestor^a common ancestor 共同祖先|ancient^ancient history 古代史
column2: Analysis of ancient farming records can help researchers understand how our ancestors anticipated demand and stored food for difficult seasons.
column3: 分析古代农业记录，有助于研究者理解祖先如何预测需求，并为艰难季节储存粮食。

column1: anxiety^anxiety about 对……的焦虑|anxious^be anxious about 为……担忧|appoint^appoint someone to 任命某人担任……|apart^apart from 除……之外
column2: Apart from appointing more career advisers, universities should address the anxiety of students who feel anxious about entering an uncertain labour market.
column3: 除了任命更多职业顾问，大学还应处理学生因进入不确定的劳动力市场而产生的焦虑。

column1: apartment^an apartment building 公寓楼|appreciate^appreciate the value of 理解……的价值|approach^an approach to ……的方法|appropriate^be appropriate for 适合……
column2: An approach appropriate for suburban houses may fail in apartment buildings, where planners must appreciate the value of shared space.
column3: 适合郊区住宅的方法可能不适用于公寓楼；在公寓楼里，规划者必须理解共享空间的价值。

column1: apology^make an apology 道歉|approval^win approval 获得批准|approximate^an approximate figure 大致数字|appeal^appeal to 吸引；向……呼吁
column2: After an approximate cost estimate won approval, the council issued an apology when the final figure proved far less appealing to taxpayers.
column3: 一份大致的成本估算获批后，最终金额却远不如最初那样能让纳税人接受，市政委员会随后道歉。

column1: appear^appear to do 似乎做……|architect^a leading architect 杰出建筑师|applause^a round of applause 一阵掌声|appliance^household appliances 家用电器
column2: The architect received a round of applause for homes that appeared ordinary but used household appliances far more efficiently.
column3: 这位建筑师设计的住宅看似普通，家电使用却高效得多，因此赢得了一阵掌声。

column1: argue^argue for 主张……|arouse^arouse interest 激起兴趣|arrange^arrange for 安排……|array^a wide array of 各种各样的……
column2: Teachers argue for arranging a wider array of practical activities to arouse interest among pupils who struggle with abstract lessons.
column3: 教师主张安排更多种类的实践活动，以激发那些难以理解抽象课程的学生的兴趣。

column1: ascend^ascend to 上升至……|artistic^artistic expression 艺术表达
column2: As art prices ascend, buyers should remember that financial returns and artistic value do not necessarily rise together.
column3: 艺术品价格上升时，买家应记得，财务回报与艺术价值未必同步增长。

column1: ascribe^ascribe A to B 把A归因于B|arise^arise from 由……引起
column2: Problems ascribed to individual laziness may actually arise from systems that give workers little control over their time or training.
column3: 被归因于个人懒惰的问题，实际上可能源于员工对时间或培训缺少控制权的制度。

column1: ashamed^be ashamed of 因……感到羞愧|arrest^under arrest 被逮捕|arrive^arrive at a conclusion 得出结论|aspect^an aspect of ……的一个方面
column2: Before arriving at a conclusion about a person under arrest, the public should consider every aspect of the case rather than assume that feeling ashamed proves guilt.
column3: 对被逮捕者作出结论之前，公众应考虑案件的各个方面，而非因为当事人表现得羞愧就假定其有罪。

column1: aspire^aspire to do 渴望做……|assemble^assemble a team 组建团队
column2: Residents aspiring to improve their neighbourhood assembled a team that combined local knowledge with professional experience in housing design.
column3: 希望改善社区的居民组建了一支团队，把本地知识与住房设计专业经验结合起来。

column1: assault^an assault on 对……的攻击
column2: An assault on a bus driver can affect more than one person, prompting staff to question whether their employer provides adequate protection.
column3: 袭击公交司机可能影响不止一个人，促使员工质疑雇主是否提供了充分保护。

column1: arrow^an arrow pointing to 指向……的箭头
column2: An arrow pointing towards an exit is useful only if passengers can see it clearly and follow a route that remains accessible.
column3: 指向出口的箭头，只有在乘客看得清楚、且所指路线保持通畅时，才有用。

column1: assert^assert that 断言……|article^a newspaper article 报纸文章|asset^a valuable asset 宝贵资产|artificial^artificial intelligence 人工智能
column2: The article asserts that human judgement remains a valuable asset even as artificial intelligence takes over more routine tasks.
column3: 这篇文章断言，即使人工智能接管更多常规任务，人类判断力仍是一项宝贵资产。

column1: assign^assign a task 分派任务|attendant^a flight attendant 乘务员|assist^assist someone with 帮助某人做……|assistant^a research assistant 研究助理
column2: A research assistant assigned to study airport access worked with attendants who assist passengers with limited mobility.
column3: 一名受派研究机场无障碍设施的研究助理，与帮助行动不便旅客的服务人员合作。

column1: attention^pay attention to 注意……|attitude^an attitude towards 对……的态度|associate^associate A with B 把A与B联系起来|attract^attract attention 吸引注意
column2: Advertisements attract attention by associating products with desirable lifestyles, which can gradually alter consumers' attitudes towards spending.
column3: 广告通过把产品与理想生活方式联系起来吸引注意，这可能逐渐改变消费者对花钱的态度。

column1: attractive^an attractive option 有吸引力的选择|assume^assume responsibility 承担责任|attribute^attribute A to B 把A归因于B|auction^at auction 在拍卖会上
column2: Buyers at auction may attribute an object's appeal to its history, assuming that an attractive story guarantees lasting value.
column3: 拍卖会上的买家可能把物品的吸引力归因于其历史，想当然地认为动人的故事能保证持久价值。

column1: assurance^quality assurance 质量保证|audience^a target audience 目标受众|assure^assure someone that 向某人保证……|audio^audio recordings 录音
column2: Audio recordings aimed at older audiences must assure listeners that quality assurance extends to both clear sound and accurate information.
column3: 面向老年受众的录音，必须让听众确信，质量保证既包括清晰声音，也包括准确信息。

column1: audit^an independent audit 独立审计|augment^augment income 增加收入|athlete^a professional athlete 职业运动员|atmosphere^a working atmosphere 工作氛围
column2: An independent audit examined whether sponsorship augmented athletes' incomes without creating an atmosphere in which commercial demands controlled sporting decisions.
column3: 一项独立审计考察了赞助是否既增加运动员收入，又没有制造让商业要求左右体育决策的氛围。

column1: aural^aural skills 听觉技能|attach^attach importance to 重视……|author^the author of ……的作者|attack^come under attack 受到攻击
column2: The author attaches importance to aural skills, but her proposal came under attack from teachers who feared that reading would receive less attention.
column3: 作者重视听觉技能，但她的提议遭到一些教师批评，他们担心阅读会受到较少关注。

column1: authority^local authorities 地方当局|attain^attain a goal 达成目标|automatic^an automatic response 自动反应|attempt^an attempt to do 做……的尝试
column2: Local authorities installed automatic warnings in an attempt to attain safer roads, but signs alone could not change dangerous driving habits.
column3: 地方当局试图通过安装自动警示装置实现更安全的道路，但仅靠标识无法改变危险驾驶习惯。

column1: automation^industrial automation 工业自动化|attend^attend to 处理；照料|automobile^the automobile industry 汽车工业|autonomy^professional autonomy 职业自主权
column2: Automation in the automobile industry can give technicians greater autonomy if it frees them to attend to problems requiring human judgement.
column3: 汽车工业的自动化如果能让技术人员腾出精力处理需要人类判断的问题，就可以赋予他们更大的自主权。

column1: avail^to no avail 徒劳无功|average^on average 平均而言|avert^avert a crisis 避免危机|avoid^avoid doing 避免做……
column2: Attempts to avert the crisis were to no avail because officials relied on average incomes to avoid discussing the unequal distribution of wealth.
column3: 避免危机的尝试徒劳无功，因为官员借平均收入回避讨论财富分配不均的问题。

column1: await^await a decision 等待决定|awake^stay awake 保持清醒|award^be awarded a prize 获奖|aware^be aware of 意识到……
column2: While awaiting the award decision, the researcher remained awake, aware that recognition might determine whether her project received further support.
column3: 等待奖项结果时，这位研究者一直醒着，因为她知道，能否获奖可能决定项目是否获得后续支持。

column1: away^do away with 废除；取消|awful^an awful experience 糟糕的经历|awkward^an awkward situation 尴尬处境|bachelor^a bachelor's degree 学士学位
column2: Graduates with bachelor's degrees can face awkward situations when employers do away with training, turning a first job into an awful experience.
column3: 雇主取消培训时，拥有学士学位的毕业生可能陷入尴尬，使第一份工作变成糟糕经历。

column1: background^a social background 社会背景|backward^a backward step 倒退|balance^strike a balance 取得平衡|band^a narrow band of 狭窄范围的……
column2: Selecting candidates from a narrow band of social backgrounds would be a backward step for institutions trying to strike a balance between merit and inclusion.
column3: 对试图平衡能力选拔与包容性的机构来说，只从狭窄的社会背景范围选人会是一种倒退。

column1: bankrupt^go bankrupt 破产|barely^barely enough 勉强足够|bargain^collective bargaining 集体谈判；a bargain 便宜货|barren^barren land 贫瘠土地
column2: Farms on barren land barely earned enough to survive, weakening workers' bargaining power as more owners feared going bankrupt.
column3: 贫瘠土地上的农场收入勉强维持生计，更多农场主担心破产，工人的议价能力也随之减弱。

column1: barrier^a barrier to ……的障碍|base^be based on 基于……|basic^basic needs 基本需要|basis^on the basis of 根据……
column2: On the basis of household surveys, planners identified high rents as a barrier to meeting basic needs and based their proposals on that finding.
column3: 根据家庭调查，规划者认定高租金妨碍基本需求的满足，并据此提出建议。

column1: batch^a batch of 一批……|battery^battery life 电池续航|battle^a battle against 与……的斗争|beam^a beam of light 一束光
column2: A batch of street lamps using narrow beams and longer-lasting batteries became part of the city's battle against energy waste.
column3: 一批使用窄光束与长寿命电池的路灯，成为这座城市减少能源浪费举措的一部分。

column1: beautiful^natural beauty 自然美；a beautiful landscape 美丽景观|because^because of 因为……|behalf^on behalf of 代表……|behave^behave responsibly 负责任地行事
column2: Speaking on behalf of residents, the guide asked visitors to behave responsibly because the beautiful landscape depended on careful protection.
column3: 导游代表居民要求游客负责任地行事，因为这片美丽景观有赖于悉心保护。

column1: behavior^consumer behavior 消费者行为|believe^believe in 相信……|belong^belong to 属于……|beneficial^be beneficial to 对……有益
column2: Consumer behavior suggests that people value products belonging to local traditions because they believe such purchases are beneficial to their community.
column3: 消费者行为表明，人们珍视属于本地传统的产品，因为他们相信这样购买有益于社区。

column1: benefit^benefit from 从……受益|betray^betray someone's trust 辜负某人的信任|beware^beware of 提防……|bill^pay a bill 付账
column2: Consumers benefit from comparing bills, but they should beware of firms that betray their trust by hiding extra charges in small print.
column3: 比较账单能让消费者受益，但他们应提防那些在小字条款里隐藏额外收费、辜负其信任的公司。

column1: billion^billions of 数十亿……|biology^conservation biology 保护生物学|blame^be to blame for 对……负有责任|blank^fill in the blanks 填补空白
column2: Billions spent on conservation biology cannot fill in every blank in our knowledge, so no single factor should automatically be blamed for species decline.
column3: 投入保护生物学的数十亿资金，也不能填补所有知识空白，因此不能自动把物种减少归咎于单一因素。

column1: bleak^a bleak outlook 黯淡前景|block^block access to 阻止访问……|blouse^a silk blouse 丝绸女衬衫|blueprint^a blueprint for ……的蓝图
column2: A blueprint for online retail promised to sell silk blouses worldwide, but blocked payment services left the small business facing a bleak outlook.
column3: 一份网络零售蓝图曾承诺向全球销售丝绸女衬衫，但支付服务受阻，使这家小企业面临黯淡前景。

column1: blunder^make a blunder 犯大错|blunt^a blunt instrument 不够精细的工具|boast^boast about 夸耀……|bonus^a performance bonus 绩效奖金
column2: Managers who boast about performance bonuses may overlook a major blunder: using pay as a blunt instrument to solve every motivation problem.
column3: 夸耀绩效奖金的管理者可能忽视一个大错：把薪酬当作解决所有激励问题的粗放工具。

column1: boost^boost confidence 增强信心|boycott^boycott a product 抵制产品|breach^a breach of trust 违背信任|breakdown^a breakdown in communication 沟通中断
column2: A consumer boycott following a breach of trust showed that boosting sales required repairing the breakdown in communication, not merely lowering prices.
column3: 违背信任后发生的消费者抵制表明，要提高销量，就需要修复中断的沟通，而非仅仅降价。

column1: brief^in brief 简言之|brilliant^a brilliant idea 出色的想法|bronze^a bronze statue 青铜雕像|browse^browse through 浏览……
column2: Visitors browsing through the museum guide found a brilliant explanation of how bronze statues were made, presented in brief and accessible language.
column3: 游客浏览博物馆指南时，发现了一段关于青铜雕像制作方法的精彩说明，语言简洁易懂。

column1: bully^bully someone into doing 威逼某人做……|burden^a financial burden 经济负担|business^do business with 与……做生意|bypass^bypass a rule 绕过规则
column2: Small businesses burdened by debt may be bullied into bypassing safety rules by clients who threaten to take their business elsewhere.
column3: 债台高筑的小企业，可能被以转移业务相威胁的客户逼迫，绕过安全规定。

column1: calculate^calculate the cost 计算成本|calendar^a calendar year 日历年|campaign^an advertising campaign 广告活动|campus^on campus 在校园里
column2: Students calculated how much an advertising campaign on campus would cost over a calendar year before seeking support from local shops.
column3: 学生在向当地商店寻求支持前，计算了校园广告活动一个日历年的成本。

column1: candidate^a suitable candidate 合适人选|capable^be capable of 能够……|capacity^the capacity to do 做……的能力|capital^human capital 人力资本
column2: A candidate's capacity to learn may reveal more about human capital than a certificate showing only what the person is currently capable of doing.
column3: 与只表明目前能做什么的证书相比，求职者的学习能力可能更能体现其人力资本。

column1: capture^capture attention 吸引注意|care^take care of 照顾……|career^career development 职业发展|careful^be careful about 对……谨慎
column2: Although dramatic career advice captures attention, workers should be careful about neglecting the people they take care of when planning their next move.
column3: 尽管耸动的职业建议吸引注意，劳动者规划下一步时，仍应谨慎，避免忽视自己照顾的人。

column1: carrier^a disease carrier 病原携带者|casual^casual employment 临时雇佣
column2: Casual workers who are carriers of an infectious disease may continue working if staying at home means losing their only income.
column3: 携带传染病病原的临时工，如果待在家里就失去唯一收入来源，可能仍会继续上班。

column1: catalog^a product catalog 产品目录|category^fall into a category 归入某类别
column2: A clear product catalog groups goods into meaningful categories, helping buyers compare useful features rather than rely entirely on advertising.
column3: 清晰的产品目录把商品归入有意义的类别，帮助买家比较实用功能，而非完全依赖广告。

column1: catastrophe^an environmental catastrophe 环境灾难|cause^a cause of ……的原因|caution^with caution 谨慎地|cautious^be cautious about 对……谨慎
column2: Claims that a single technology caused the environmental catastrophe should be treated with caution; a cautious investigation must examine several interacting factors.
column3: 关于某项技术单独导致环境灾难的说法，应谨慎对待；审慎的调查必须考察多个相互作用的因素。

column1: cease^cease to do 停止做……|celebrate^celebrate an achievement 庆祝成就|century^over the past century 在过去一个世纪|certain^be certain of 确信……
column2: Over the past century, societies have celebrated many scientific achievements without ever becoming certain that progress will cease to create new problems.
column3: 过去一个世纪里，社会庆祝了许多科学成就，却从未能确信进步会不再产生新问题。

column1: certainty^with certainty 确定地|certificate^a birth certificate 出生证明|certify^certify that 证明……|challenge^challenge an assumption 质疑假设
column2: A certificate may certify that training was completed, but it cannot establish competence with certainty, a distinction that challenges common hiring assumptions.
column3: 证书可以证明培训已经完成，却无法确定地证明能力，这一区别对常见的招聘假设提出了挑战。

column1: character^the character of ……的特性；a character in ……中的人物|characterise^be characterised by 以……为特征|characteristic^a distinctive characteristic 独特特征|charge^take charge of 负责……
column2: Small workshops characterise the district and give it a distinctive character, a characteristic that officials taking charge of redevelopment should preserve.
column3: 这个街区以小作坊为特征，负责改造的官员应保留这一独特特色。

column1: charity^a charitable donation 慈善捐赠；a charity event 慈善活动|charm^the charm of ……的魅力|chart^a bar chart 条形图|cherish^cherish a memory 珍惜回忆
column2: A charity used charts to show how donations preserved the old town's charm and the places associated with memories residents cherished.
column3: 一家慈善机构用图表说明，捐款如何保留老城的魅力，以及那些承载居民珍贵回忆的地方。

column1: child^a child's development 儿童的发展|childhood^early childhood 童年早期|choice^make a choice 作出选择|chronic^chronic stress 长期压力
column2: Choices made in early childhood can influence a child's development, but chronic stress may matter more than any single parenting decision.
column3: 童年早期作出的选择会影响儿童发展，但长期压力可能比任何一次育儿决定都更重要。

column1: circular^a circular economy 循环经济|circulate^circulate information 传播信息|cite^cite evidence 引用证据|citizen^a senior citizen 老年公民
column2: Citizens need clear information about the circular economy, yet reports circulating online often cite evidence without explaining its limitations.
column3: 公民需要了解循环经济的清晰信息，但网上流传的报告引用证据时，往往没有说明其局限。

column1: civil^civil rights 公民权利|civilise^a civilised society 文明社会|claim^make a claim 提出主张；索赔|clarify^clarify a point 澄清一点
column2: A society that claims to be civilised must clarify how it protects civil rights when public opinion turns against an unpopular minority.
column3: 一个自称文明的社会，必须说明当舆论反对不受欢迎的少数群体时，它如何保护公民权利。

column1: clarity^clarity of purpose 目的明确|classic^a classic example 典型例子|clause^a clause in a contract 合同条款|client^a client relationship 客户关系
column2: A confusing clause in a client contract is a classic example of how a lack of clarity can damage an otherwise successful business relationship.
column3: 客户合同中令人费解的条款，是表述不清如何破坏原本良好业务关系的典型例子。

column1: climate^climate change 气候变化|cluster^a cluster of 一群；一簇|clutch^clutch at 抓住……|coach^a career coach 职业教练
column2: A cluster of career coaches urged graduates not to clutch at familiar jobs as climate change created demand for entirely new skills.
column3: 一群职业教练敦促毕业生不要死抓着熟悉的工作，因为气候变化正催生对全新技能的需求。

column1: coast^along the coast 沿海岸|cognitive^cognitive development 认知发展|coherent^a coherent account 连贯的说明|coincide^coincide with 与……同时发生；相符
column2: A coherent account of children's cognitive development must explain why changes along the coast coincide with changes in outdoor play.
column3: 对儿童认知发展的连贯说明，必须解释沿海社区的变化为何与户外游戏的变化同时发生。

column1: collaborate^collaborate with 与……合作|colleague^a former colleague 前同事|collect^collect data 收集数据|collection^a collection of 一批……
column2: Colleagues collaborating with local museums collected oral histories, creating a collection of accounts that would otherwise have been lost.
column3: 与当地博物馆合作的同事收集了口述历史，保存了一批原本可能失传的叙述。

column1: college^a college graduate 大学毕业生|colony^a colony of 一群……|column^a newspaper column 报纸专栏|command^have a good command of 熟练掌握……
column2: A college graduate with a good command of statistics wrote a newspaper column explaining how urban development affected a colony of seabirds.
column3: 一名熟练掌握统计学的大学毕业生，在报纸专栏中解释了城市开发如何影响一群海鸟。

column1: commend^commend someone for 因……表扬某人|comment^comment on 评论……|commerce^electronic commerce 电子商务|commission^earn a commission 赚取佣金
column2: Commenting on electronic commerce, the report commended platforms that disclosed the commissions earned by people recommending products.
column3: 报告在评论电子商务时，赞扬了那些公开产品推荐者所获佣金的平台。

column1: committee^a committee member 委员会成员|common^have something in common 有共同之处|communication^effective communication 有效沟通|community^a local community 当地社区
column2: Committee members found that effective communication helped local communities discover common interests despite their different priorities.
column3: 委员会成员发现，尽管优先事项不同，有效沟通仍帮助当地社区发现了共同利益。

column1: compact^a compact design 紧凑设计|companion^a travelling companion 旅伴|company^keep someone company 陪伴某人|comparable^be comparable to 与……相当
column2: A compact care robot may keep an older person company, but its responses are not yet comparable to those of a human companion.
column3: 设计紧凑的照护机器人可以陪伴老年人，但它的回应尚不能与人类伙伴相提并论。

column1: comparison^in comparison with 与……相比|compartment^a separate compartment 独立隔间|compete^compete with 与……竞争|competition^competition for 对……的竞争
column2: In comparison with open offices, separate compartments reduce noise but may encourage competition for private space among colleagues who already compete for promotion.
column3: 与开放式办公室相比，独立隔间能减少噪声，却可能使本已争取晋升的同事进一步争夺私人空间。

column1: competitive^a competitive advantage 竞争优势|complain^complain about 抱怨……|complex^a complex issue 复杂问题|complicate^complicate matters 使事情复杂化
column2: Companies seeking a competitive advantage often complain about regulation, but removing rules can complicate already complex questions of consumer protection.
column3: 寻求竞争优势的公司常常抱怨监管，但取消规则可能使本就复杂的消费者保护问题更加复杂。

column1: comply^comply with 遵守……|component^a key component 关键组成部分|compose^be composed of 由……组成|composite^composite materials 复合材料
column2: Manufacturers using composite materials must ensure that every component complies with standards, even when the finished product is composed of many suppliers' parts.
column3: 使用复合材料的制造商，必须确保每个部件都符合标准，即便成品由许多供应商的零件组成。

column1: compound^compound a problem 使问题加重|comprehend^comprehend the meaning 理解含义|compulsory^compulsory education 义务教育|computer^computer skills 计算机技能
column2: Making computer lessons compulsory can compound inequality if pupils lack the basic reading skills needed to comprehend the instructions.
column3: 如果学生缺少理解指令所需的基本阅读技能，把计算机课程设为必修，可能加重不平等。

column1: concede^concede that 承认……|concept^a key concept 关键概念|concern^be concerned about 担心……|concert^in concert with 与……协同
column2: Working in concert with teachers, researchers conceded that parents concerned about new learning concepts deserved clearer explanations.
column3: 研究者与教师协同工作时承认，担忧新学习概念的家长理应得到更清晰的解释。
